samples.hyp: Ukuhlola amazinga okudinga ukuhlolwa kwe-SARS-CoV-2 kuzo zonke izindawo ukuze kwenziwe ukulawulwa okungenzeka kokubhebhetheka kwesifo esifundeni elikhulu le-Lusaka eZambia, kucabangelwa abantu abangenazimpawu:
Ucwaningo olu lula lwe modeli yezibalo

Isifo esisha sokhuvethe (COVID-19), esidalwa yi-severe acute respiratory syndrome coronavirus—2 (SARS-CoV-2), e-Afrika siphawulwa yiningi labantu abangenazimpawu (noma abanezimpango ezilula) okucatshangwa ukuthi badlala indima ekusakazweni kwalesi sifo.
Izinga nezinga lokutheleleka kwabantu abangenazimpawu alisobala.
Nokho, izifundo zibonisa ukuthi ukuphathwa kwabo kubalulekile ekulawuleni ukudlulisa kwe-SARS-CoV-2.

Senze imodeli yezibalo elula yokunquma yo-sengozini-oluvezwe-ethelelanayo-osuswe (SEIR) ukuhlola umphumela wokwahlukaniswa okusebenzayo kwabantu abane-SARS-CoV-2 abangenazimpawu ngokuhlolwa okubanzi ukulawula ukuphazamiseka eSifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia.
Lapha siye saklama izimo ezimbili; (1) sicabanga ukuthi abantu abangenazimpawu bahlanganisa u-70% wazo zonke izimo ze-COVID-19, kanye ne-(2) abantu abangenazimpawu bahlanganisa u-50% kuphela wezimo.

Ukuze kuqhathaniswe, imodeli ihlolwe kuqala ngaphansi kokubheka ukuthi abantu abangenazimpawu bangathelelanisa ngokulinganayo njengabantu abanezibonakaliso bese kuthi kwesibili, futhi kungenzeka kakhulu, ngokubheka ukuthi abantu abangenazimpawu bangathelelanisa ngengxenye kuphela njengabantu abanezibonakaliso.

Kule modeli eqagela amacala angenasimpawu angu-70%, izinga lokulinga elihlala liqhubeka nsuku zonke elingaphezulu noma elingalingana nezivivinyo ezingu-7911/abantu bendawo abangu-100 000 lwanele ukulawula ukuqubuka uma abantu abangenazimpawu beba yingxenye kuphela yokuthelelana, kuyilapho uma kufakwa ukuthelelana okulinganayo, izinga lokulinga elingaphezulu noma elingalingana nezivivinyo ezingu-10028/abantu bendawo abangu-100 000 lizobe liyadingeka.

Kubantu abangenazimpawu abangama-50%, amazinga okulinga okungenani angu-≥ 4540 ama-test/ abantu bendawo abayi-100 000 ayanele ukulawula ukuqubuka kumazinga omabili acatshangelwayo okuthelelana kwabantu abangenazimpawu uma kuqhathaniswa nabantu abanezifo.
Ingxoxo nesiphetho

Imodeli yethu ibikezela ukuthi ukuzihlukanisa okusebenzayo kwamacala e-COVID-19, okuhlanganisa nabantu abangenazimpawu, ngokusebenzisa ukuhlolwa okubanzi kungenziwa njengendlela engenzeka yokulawula ukudlulisa i-SARS-Cov-2 eLusaka, eZambia, kodwa kuzoba yiyona ebizayo kakhulu.
Ukuhlolwa kwabantu abaningi emadolobheni amakhulu njengaseLusaka kunganciphisa ukubhebhetheka kwe-COVID-19, kodwa ingabe kuyasebenza?
Ngo-2020, amamodeli eekhompyutha abikezela ukuthi ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu bekungalawulwa kangcono ngokuhlolwa kwabantu abaningi, bese kuthi bonke abavivinya kahle bahlukaniswe.
Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathi le ndlela ingabiza futhi ingasebenzi kahle.
Ekuqaleni kwempathamhlaba, abantu abaningi ababethelelwe yi-COVID-19 babengenawo ubufakazi besifo, kodwa basabalalisa lesi sifo kwabanye.
Ezinye izifundo zikhombe ukuthi abantu abangu-50% kuya ku-80% abane-COVID-19 babengenazimpawu (okungenazimpawu) futhi kungenzeka ukuthi babengabangela izifo ezintsha ezingama-40% kuya ku-70%.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukwazi ukuthi ukuthola nokuhlukanisa abantu abangenazimpawu kuzosiza yini ukulawula ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19.
Babefuna futhi ukwazi ukuthi ukuhlolwa kweqembu, okusho ukuhlola abantu abaningi ngokungahleliwe, kuthola ngempumelelo yini abantu abangenazimpawu.
Abacwaningi benze imodeli yekhompyutha ebikezela ukuthi abantu badlula kanjani ekubeni sengozini baye ekuvezweni, ukutheleleka, nokuhlukaniswa.
Bagxile kulwazi oluvela esifundazweni saseLusaka eZambia, okuyindawo ebalulekile yebhizinisi enendawo yokuhamba ngezindiza yamazwe ngamazwe ehlala emingceleni yezwe ezimbili.

Ngenxa yokuthi izimpawu ze-COVID-19 zibonakala zingahlukani endaweni neyindawo, babheke izimo ezine, lapho ama-50% noma ama-70% ezimo ze-COVID-19 ayengenazimpawu, futhi lezi zimo zazilingana noma zazingama-half njengoba zinethelelanayo njengezimpawu.

Imodeli yabacwaningi ithole ukuthi bekungenzeka ukulawula ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 ngokwenza ama-test answer abantu bonke nangokuhlukanisa bonke abantu abavele be-positive, ngisho nalabo abangenayo imimonyo.
Bathe ukuze kuncishiswe inani elikhulu lezigameko ngama-90% kuzo zonke izimo, kwakudingeka kuhlolwe abantu abangu-10% eLusaka nsuku zonke.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi uma sifuna ukugcina inani lezifo ezintsha ze-Covid-19 lingashintshi, kwakudingeka kuhlolwe abantu abangu-22% nsuku zonke.
Naphezu kokuba iZambia ibeke izindlela eziningi zokulinganisela i-COVID-19, izingameko zibonakala zisaphakama.
Ukuhlolwa kwabaningi kwehlise ngempumelelo inani lamacala e-COVID-19 ngo-90% edolobheni elincane e-Italy.
Kodwa, azikho izifundo zangaphambili ezibonisa ukuthi kungase kube nomphumela emzini omkhulu kwenye indawo.

Qaphela ukuthi abacwaningi abazange benze ukuhlolwa okubanzi kulesifundo; kunalokho, benze imodeli ephakamisa ukuthi ukuhlolwa okubanzi kungasebenze ekuvimbeleni ukusabalala kwe-COVID-19 emadolobheni amakhulu.
Kodwa-ke, baxwayisa ukuthi cishe kuyoba yibiza kakhulu.
Baphindé bathi kungase kube lula kakhulu uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinyathelo, ezifana nokuvala izwe, ukulandelela abantu abathintwayo, kanye nokugoma.
Abacwaningi baseZambia baphindé bagcizelela ukuthi izigameko ze-COVID-19 ezingenazimpawu zibonakala zivame kakhulu e-Afrika ngaleso sikhathi.
Ukungenzeki okuvamile kwemiphumela yezakhi zofuzo eziningi kubantu base-Afrika ngenxa yokuhlukahluka kofuzo nemvelo.
Abantu base-Afrika abameleki kahle ezincwaningweni zofuzo, kodwa banokwahlukahlukana okukhulu kwezakhi zofuzo futhi bahlangana nokuvezwa okubanzi komkhathi emhlabeni jikelele.

Ngenxa yokuthi ukulinganiswa okuhleliwe kokubikezelwa kofuzo bekungakawenzi ezinhlwini zezalukazi ezimbozwe ukwahlukahluka kwe-Afrika, sibale amaphuzu omngcipheko wofuzo oluhlanganisiwe (PRS) ekuqaguleleni kulo lonke elase-Afrika nasezulwini lokucwaninga oluvela eNingizimu Afrika, e-Uganda, nase-UK ukuze siqonde kangcono ukusebenza kwesifundo sokuhlukahluka kofuzo.
Ukunemba kwe-PRS kuyaqhubeka kuthuthuka ngamaqembu okutholakala afanayo ngokwemvelaphi kunokufunda okungafani ngokwemvelaphi.
Phakathi kwabaseNingizimu Afrika abanobuzwe nohlanga oluhlukahlukene, siyabona ukuthi ukunemba kwe-PRS kuphansi kuzo zonke izimpawu kodwa kuyahlukahluka phakathi kwamaqembu.
Ukwehluka kwezizukulwane zase-Afrika kunegalelo elikhulu ekungalingani kokunemba kwe-PRS kunokwehluka kwezinye izigaba ezinkulu ezicatshangelwe phakathi kwabantu base-UK nebase-Uganda.

Sikhompyuthile i-PRS kubantu abanezizukulwane zase-Afrika usebenzisa izifundo zofuzo zase-Europe kuphela ngokumelene nezifundo zofuzo ezihlukahlukene ngokwemvelaphi; ukuhlukahluka okwandayo kwenze ukuzuza kokunemba okukhulu ekugxileni kwe-hemoglobin nezinombolo zamaseli egazi amhlophe, kubonisa ukuguqulwa okuthinta kakhulu okunomthelela okunomthelela wokhokho okunomthelela ezakhi zegazi ezaziwa ngokuthi zithinta isifo se-sickle cell nempendulo yokuzala, ngokulandelana.

Ukwehluka kokunemba kwe-PRS phakathi kwezizukulwane zase-Afrika ezivela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene kukhulu njengoba kunjalo phakathi kwezizukulwane zase-continental ezingaphandle kwe-Afrika, okudinga ukuqonda okuhambisanayo.
Kungani singakwazi ukubikezela ngokuqondile izifo zofuzo kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika
Abacwaningi bathi izindlela ezisetshenziswayo okwamanje zokubikezela ukuthi umuntu uzophuka yini isifo sofuzo noma cha azisebenzi kahle kubantu abavela e-Afrika.
Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi idatha bese kuqagelwa ngayo ikakhulukazi ichaza ufuzo lwabantu bozalo lwase-Europe.
I-database ye-GWAS imele “izifundo ze-Genome-Wide Association”, futhi ososayensi bayisebenzisa ukubheka izimpawu nezifo ngokusekelwe ebufuzwini.
Eqinisweni, bangayisebenzisa i-GWAS ukubala ingozi yofuzo yomuntu yesifo noma isici.
Iningi lolwazi lwe-jini e-GWAS, noma kunjalo, livela kubantu bomdabu wase-Europe.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukubona ukuthi ukubala abakusebenzisayo ukuthola ingozi yesifo sofuzo kusebenzisa i-GWAS kusebenza kangakanani kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika.
Babefisa futhi ukubona ukuthi i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu, ngamanye amazwi idatha yasekhompyutha ehlanganisa ulwazi oluningi lwezakhi zofuzo zase-Afrika, ingathuthukisa yini ukubikezela.
Lokhu kubalwa kuwaziwa ngamagama esayensi ngokuthi “umphumela wezingozi eziningi zofuzo”, noma i-PRS.

Basebenzise ama-khompyutha ukubala ubungozi obuqikelelwe bofuzo babantu base-Afrika basebenzisa i-GWAS, futhi basebenzise amarekhodi ezempilo abantu base-Afrika ukubuka izimpawu ezithile noma izifo ezingase zibe zibangelwe yizinguquko e-ufuzweni.

Lapho belisebenzisa i-GWAS yase-Europe, bathole ukuthi umphumela wezingozi zezakhi zofuzo wawunembile kakhulu uma abantu bebenozalo lwase-Europe uma kuqhathaniswa nozalo lwase-Afrika ezintweni eziningi.
Bathi amaphuzu omngcipheko aphansi kakhulu phakathi kwezindawo zase-Afrika ngoba kunokuhlukahluka okukhulu phakathi kwabantu bendawo, okungafani nalokho esikubonayo ngokuzalwa kwaseYurophu.
Baphinda bathi ukunemba kwe-PRS kukhula njengoba imvelaphi yase-Afrika iyancipha.
Abantu base-Ethiopia babe neziprofetho ezinhle zezifo zofuzo njengoba bekhona ukufana okukhulu ngofuzo nabantu base-Europe.
Uma kusetshenziswa i-GWAS ehlukahlukene kakhulu ehlanganisa abantu abavela e-Afrika, ukunemba kokubikezela kuye kwathuthuka.
Ukuqagela izifo zegazi kwakunembile ngokukhethekile.
Ucwaningo oluthile selubonise ukuthi i-PRS iphansi kubantu base-Afrika, kusho ukuthi idatha yase-GWAS ibikezela ingozi ephansi yezifo zofuzo kubantu bomdabu wase-Afrika.
Kodwa siyazi ukuthi lokhu akuyona iqiniso.

Le ncwadi ichaza ukuthi le miphumela ephansi yengozi yesifo sofuzo iyimbangela yokuthi ufuzo lwase-Afrika alumeleki kahle kwedatha yase-GWAS, ngakho-ke amanani akwamanje e-PRS awasizi ngempela ekubikezeleni izifo zofuzo e-Afrika.
Abacwaningi bathi kungcono ukusebenzisa idatha bese ihlukahlukene efaka ulwazi lwezakhi zofuzo lwabantu bozalo lwase-Afrika.
Ngakho-ke, kudingeka umsebenzi owengeziwe ukuze kuhlukahlukiswe i-GWAS ukuze kuhlanganiswe izizukulwane zase-Afrika ukuze sikwazi ukubikezela ngokuqondile ubungozi bezifo zofuzo kubantu base-Afrika.
Ababhali balolu cwaningo bebeqhamuka e-Afrika, e-USA nase-UK.
Ukulinganisa Ukuhlolwa Ngokubonakala Ngokuqondile Nokuhlolwa Kwe-Cytology Ekwenzeni Ukuvimbela i-Neoplasia Yaphakathi kwe-Epithelial Yomlomo Wesibeletho Nomdlavuza Yomlomo Wesibeletho e-Namibia
Kuqikelelwa ukuthi abesifazane abangu-851 340 eNamibia baphazanyiswe yi-HPV engabangela umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho.
Ukuhlolwa ngeso lengqondo nge-acetic acid (VIA) kanye ne-cryotherapy kuye kwabonakala kuyasebenza kakhulu.
Nokho, ulwazi oluhambisana nethonya lemihlahlandlela yokuhlolwa komdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho alukho.
Lolu cwaningo luhlolwe ukuhlolwa kokubona ngeso lengqondo nokuhlolwa kwe-cytology ekunqobeni izilonda ze-CIN nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho e-Namibia.
Imiphumela iveze ukuthi abesifazane abane-HPV, i-cervicitis, i-koilocytosis ne-atypia baphezu kokutholakala kakhulu kokuthi i-VIA ibe positive.
Abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi abane-HIV, banesigameko esikhulu sokuthola i-squamous cell carcinoma (SCC).

Inqubo ye-VIA ibonakala ifanele ekuhlolweni, nakuba ukusetshenziswa kwe-colposcopy ekulandeleleni iziguli endaweni yaseNamibia kufanele kuqwalaselwe futhi kusetshenziswe ngemiphumela eyi-positive ye-HR-HPV.
Kuyacetyiswa izindlela zokuhlola ezihlanganisa ukuhlolwa kwe-HPV kubantu bezingqondo ezahlukene nabantu bendawo abasezingozini (isib. abane-HIV, abanesifo samasosha omzimba).

Ukuketha ukuhlolwa kungathuthukiswa nakakhulu ngokungenelela okusebenzisa imodeli esebenzisa imiphumela yangaphambili yokuxilonga, imigomo yempilo yabesifazane, ulwazi olusha kanye nomkhuba ofanele isimo sezinto ezweni.
Abesifazane base-Namibia abasezingozini yomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho kufanele bahlolwe futhi baphathwe kusenesikhathi.
Izivivinyo eziningi zingabonisa ingozi yabesifazane yokuba nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho, kodwa ukuhlolwa okuvamile e-Namibia akuwasebenzisi njalo lezi zivivinyo.
Abacwaningi baphakamisa ukuhlolwa njalo, ukuthola izimpawu zokuqala, kungavimbela abesifazane ukuthi bangaphuthumi lesi sifo esibulalayo.
Umdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho (umdlavuza wezingxenye eziphansi zesibalo) ubanga ukufa kwabesifazane abaningi emhlabeni jikelele.
Esinye sezizathu ezivame kakhulu zomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho yi-Human Papillomavirus, noma i-HPV.
I-HPV iwugciwane olonakalisa amaseli esibeletho, oluveza izilonda, ezingase zifeze kube umdlavuza.
Nakuba umgomo wokuvimbela i-HPV ukhona, abesifazane abaningi emazweni ase-Afrika, kuhlanganise neNamibia, abanawo.
Lokhu kusho ukuthi ukuhlola i-virus noma izilonda ezikhiqizwa yiyo kubaluleke kakhulu kulaba besifazane, ngoba yindlela engcono kakhulu yokusiza ukuvimbela umdlavuza.
Abacwaningi kulolu cwaningo bathi ngakho-ke izibhedlela zidinga imiyalelo efanele nolwazi mayelana nezivivinyo ezinhle kakhulu okumele zisetshenziswe.
Banezela ukuthi abasebenzi bezokwelapha nabo badinga ulwazi oluthe xaxa mayelana nendlela izinto ezinjengobudala noma impilo eziqeda ingozi yabesifazane yokuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Bahlolisise ukuthi zisebenza kangakanani izinhlobo ezithile zezivivinyo (ezibizwa ngokuthi izindlela zokuhlola) zokuthola i-HPV nezilonda.
Babefuna futhi ukuqhathanisa izindlela zokuhlolwa, ngokwesibonelo ukuqoqa amangqamuzana esibelethweni ukuhlola ukulimala uma kuqathaniswa nokuthi nje ubone izilonda.

Babefuna futhi ukwazi ukuthi ukuhluka phakathi kwabesifazane, njengomnyaka wabo, noma ngabe babe nezinye izifo ezinjenge-HIV (isandulela ngculaza), kushintshe yini amathuba abo okuthola i-HPV nomdlavuza.
Ukuba nalolu lwazi kungasiza izibhedlela nama-klinikhi ukusebenzisa izindlela zokuhlolwa ngokuphumelelayo.
Abacwaningi babuke amarekhodi eziguli abesifazane abangu-214 ababehlolwe futhi baphathwe i-HPV, izilonda, nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho esibhedlela eWindhoek, eNamibia.
Bagxile ngokukhethekile emdlavuzweni womlomo wesibeletho osezingeni lokuqala, lapho isifo singelashwa kalula futhi ngokuphumelelayo.
Baqoqa nokwaziswa ngobudala bomfazi ngamunye, nempilo yakhe evamile.

Ngokuhlola lezi zikhombo, bathole ukuthi izindlela zokuhluza ezahlukene zivame ukunika abasebenzi bezokwelapha ulwazi oluhlukile, nokuthi zingase zibe usizo kakhulu ngaphambi noma ngemuva kokuthi i-HPV ibe yimdlavuza.
Isibonelo, umdlavuza wawutholakala kaningi ngokuqoqa nokucubungula amangqamuzana esibeletho.
Izilonda, noma kunjalo, zazivame ukutholakala ngokuhlola ngamehlo nje kuphela, kusetshenziswa indlela ebizwa ngokuthi “ukuhlola ngamehlo nge-acetic acid” (VIA).
Inzuzo yaleli qhinga iwukuthi liyavumela odokotela ukuthi bathole izilonda ngokushesha nangokubiza okuncane.

Lokhu kungenxa yokuthi isebenzisa imishini yezokwelapha eyisisekelo eseseyisetshenziswa ekuhlolweni kwabesifazane kwezitho zangasese, njengesipikili (isithulu sakhiwo esihlanganisiwe esisetshenziswa ukubuka ngaphakathi kwesikhumba).
Baphinda bathola ukuthi ukuhlanganisa izindlela ezahlukene kuvame ukunika odokotela ulwazi oluningi ngengozi yomfazi yokuthola umdlavuza, ikakhulukazi ngokuhlola okuningi.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abadala, ikakhulukazi labo abane-HIV, babekhona kakhulu ukutholakala benomdlavuza, ngakho ukuhlolwa kwabo njalo kungaba kubaluleke kakhulu.
Abacwaningi baphinde bathi abesifazane abambalwa kakhulu bahlolwe i-HPV (ngaphambi kokubheka izilonda) ngisho noma kukhona i-test.
Ukwenza kanjalo kungaba yindlela ebalulekile yokuthola lesi sifo ngokushesha nakakhulu.

Ngokujwayelekile, bathi imiphumela yabo ibonise ukuthi kunesidingo sohlelo lwezempilo eNamibia lokucwangcisa amasu okuvimbela i-HPV nomdlavuza womlomo wesibeletho ngokucophelela, usebenzisa izindlela zokuhlola eziphansi, eziphumelelayo ukuthola lezi zifo ngokushesha okukhulu.
Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi baseNamibia naseNingizimu Afrika.
Inzuzo yokwelashwa ekuthelelekeni kwe-HBV/HIV uma kuqathaniswa nokutholakala kwe-HBV kuphela eqoqweni laseNingizimu Afrika

Sinqotshwe imigomo yamazwe ngamazwe yokususwa kwe-HBV (imphathas’bindi/nkukhumalisa s’bindi/ i-hepatatis b), saqala ukuchaza abantu abane-HBV kuphela vs. labo abane-HBV/HIV, ukuhlola umthelela wokwelashwa nokuqondisa ukuthuthukiswa kokunakekelwa kwezokwelapha.
Sibika ulwazi oluqokiwe oluvela eqoqweni labantu abadala abangu-115 abane-imphathas’bindi/nkukhumalisa s’bindi/ i-hepatatis b amahlalakhona, esibhedlela seyunivesithi eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Ukuphathwa i-HIV kanyekanye kwakukhona kubantu abangu-39 (34%).
Siqophe ulwazi lwezigaba ezihlukene, lwasekliniki nelolwaselebhorathorini.

Uma kuqathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV ehlanganisiwe, abantu abadala abane-HBV kuphela babengavamile ukuba ne-HBeAg-positive (p=0.01), babengavamile ukuhlolwa nge-elastography (p<0.0001), futhi babengavamile ukuba esikhwameni sokwelapha ngama-antiviral (p<0.0001); babengavamile ukuba ne-HBV viraemia ebonakalayo (p=0.04), futhi babengavamile ukuba nezici zesifo sesibindi okuhlanganisa i-thrombocytopaenia ephakathi/eqatha (p=0.007), i-bilirubin ephezulu (p=0.004), kanye nomphumela we-APRI ophezulu (p=0.02).
Izimo ezintathu ze-hephathoselula sasincoma zonke zaqala ngokuqabukela kwe-HBV kuphela.

Ulwazi lwethu lubonisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV kuphela bangase babe sengozini uma beqathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV, lokhu kuqokomisa ukungalingani okungenzeka ehlelweni lokudluliselwa, ukulandelela nokwelashwa.
Abacwaningi banikeza imiyalelo yokuthuthukisa ukwelashwa kwe-hepatatis B.
Kwifundo lamuva nje, abacwaningi bakwazile ukugqamisa ukuthi ukutheleleka yi-hepatatis B (HBV) ne-HIV (isandulela ngculaza) kungaba nenzuzo ekwelapheni uma kuqhathaniswa nokutholakala yi-HBV kuphela.
Emazweni aseNingizimu Afrika, ukutheleleka okungamahlalakhona kwe-HBV ne-HIV kuyinkinga enkulu.
Odokotela kudingeka baqonde ukuthi le migciwane nemithi esetshenziswa ukuyilapha ihlangana kanjani, ukuze bakwazi ukuxilonga nokunakekela iziguli kangcono.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukuqhathanisa imiphumela yokuwelapha kwabaguli abane-HBV kuphela, nabaguli abane-HBV ne-HIV.
Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi babutha iziguli ezinkulu ezingama-115 ezine-imphathas’bindi/nkukhumalisa s’bindi/ i-hepatatis b amahlalakhona.
Baqashelwe esibhedlela iTygerberg eKapa, eNingizimu Afrika.
Abanye abagulayo babephethwe yi-HIV (39) kwathi abanye babephethwe yi-HBV kuphela.
Abacwaningi babheke uhlanga, iminyaka nobulili, futhi benze izinhlobo ezahlukene zezivivinyo zezokwelapha nezelabhoratri.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli ezinobhubhane lwe-HBV kuphela zazingavamile ukuthola noma iyiphi uhlobo lokwelashwa ngemithi yokulwa nezinambuzane, zibonisa izimpawu zemvelo zesifo sesibindi (njengoba i-HBV iyigciwane elingabangela isifo sesibindi esinzima).

Abacwaningi bakwazi ukukhombisa ukuthi abantu abane-HBV kuphela babe sengozini uma kuqathaniswa nalabo abane-HIV ne-HBV, njengoba iziguli ezinezinambuzane zombili zazinezindlela zokwelapha i-HIV, okusiza ekulweni ne-HBV.

Imiphumela yalo cwaningo ikhanyisa umthelela onga khona wokwahluka phakathi kokudluliselwa, ukulandelela kanye nezinketho zokwelapha i-HBV uma kuqathaniswa ne-HIV ne-HBV ezihlangene, okuyisiza labo abane-HIV ne-HBV.
Abacwaningi bagcizelela ukuthi kumele sithuthukise futhi sinikeze isevisi ephephile futhi efanele kakhulu kulabo abane-HBV kuphela.
Omunye umkhawulo wocwaningo lolu yisibalo esincane sabantu bendawo esasingqongqotha kuphela kwenye izwe kanye nezibhedlela zalo.
Ezinye, mhlawumbe izindawo zokwelapha eziphambili zingase zikhombise umbono ohlukile uma kuqathaniswa nalokho okutholakele kuleli cwaningo.
Kumelwe kwenziwe izifundo eziningi ukuze kutholakale ngempela umehluko olutholiwe kuleli cwaningo.
Le ncwadi ibonise amandla okubambisana, kanti abacwaningi abasebenza kulo mkhankaso bevela eNingizimu Afrika nase-United Kingdom.
Ngokuyisebenzisa inani labantu baseNingizimu Afrika abagulayo kulolu cwaningo, kubalulekile engxenyeni yabantu base-Afrika.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, ucwaningo lungasiza ekuthuthukiseni izinhlelo zokwelapha ezingcono kulabo abagulayo yi-HBV, i-HIV noma zombili.
Ukuhlolwa komthelela wokungabi nabulondeleko emisebenzini yabantu basebesifazane abenza ibhizinisi eSHIRORO indawo yohulumeni wasekhaya yaseNyjeri.

Lolu cwaningo luhlolethonya lokuvikeleka okungekho emthethweni emisebenzini yabantu basebenza ngokwabo besifazane e-Shiroro, indawo yohulumeni wasekhaya e-Niger State, kugxilwe ngokukhethekile ezindabeni zokuxhomeka kwezezimali kwabesifazane, uhlobo lwemisebenzi yabantu basebenza ngokwabo evamile kubo kanye nobukhulu bethonyo lokuvikeleka okungekho emthethweni emizameni yabo yabantu basebenza ngokwabo.

Isampula yabesifazane abangu-377 ihlolwe, okuholele ekutholakaleni kokuthi abesifazane baseShiroro banesifiso esikhulu sokwenza ibhizinisi, banokuzimela ngokwezimali okuphezulu, futhi bahlanganyela ikakhulukazi emakhishini amancane.

Ucwaningo luye lwafumanisa futhi ukuthi ngenkathi ukungaphepheki kunomphumela omubi emisebenzini yabantu basebesifazane abenza ibhizinisi ngokulahleka noma ukwehla kwezimali phakathi kwezinye izinto, inani labantu basebesifazane abenza ibhizinisi alizange libe nokuhla kwehla okukhulu.

Ucwaningo lwaluncoma ukuthi kumele kudalwe izinhlelo ezinokuphila isikhathi eside zokuthuthukisa ukufinyelela kwabesifazane nelisebenzisa izinsizakalo zezezimali, futhi kumele kuqalwe futhi kuqinisekiswe izinhlangano zokuvikela umphakathi ukuze zilwe nokusilela kokuphepha endaweni ecwaningiwe.
Abesifazane basebenza eNiger badinga ukuvikeleka okwengeziwe.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi abesifazane abenza ibhizinisi eNiger bayazimisela kakhulu futhi bazimele ngokwezimali, kodwa ukuphepha ezigebengwini kuyinkinga.

Abacwaningi babefuna ukwazi ukuthi abesifazane abaphatha amabhizinisi e-Shiroro Local Government Area yaseNyakatho-Ntshonalanga bayaphepheka kangakanani, nokuthi lokhu kungathinta kanjani amabhizinisi abo nokuzimela kwezezimali.
Baxoxisana nabesifazane abangu-377 kule ndawo ngezinselele ababhekana nazo mayelana nemisebenzi yabo yebhizinisi, ukuxhomeka kwezezimali nokungakhululeki.
Bathi ama-43% wabesifazane bathi abazamiselwe yizindoda ngemali, kanti ama-32% bathi kunabanye abantu abazamiselwe yibona ngemali.
Abacwaningi bathole nokuthi abesifazane abayi-85% bathola imali emakhishini ahlukahlukene, futhi bambalwa kuphela abathi bathembele emikhawulweni yemali.
Cishe ama-56% enze imali ngokulima, kanti ama-79% ngokuhweba.
Cishe owesifazane omunye kwabayisihlanu uthole imali ngokumunca izinwele, ukubuka, ukuncela noma ukwenza izinto zokugeza.
Abesifazane abaningi (91%) batshela abacwaningi ukuthi amabhizinisi abo athinteka ukwesaba kwabo ukuhlaselwa amasela nezigebengu.
Balahlekelwa yimali ngisho namadoda abo kula mahlongandlela, ngezinye izikhathi kubaphoqa ukuba banakekele abantwana babo bodwa.
Abesifazane baphinda bathi babengenazo ezikhono ezanele nemali yokwandisa amabhizinisi abo.
Abacwaningi babike ukuthi naphezu kwalelo zinga, abesifazane baseNiger baqhubeke bephumelela kakhulu emakhishini abo.
Bathe eShiroro kwakunabantu bezizwe nezenkolo ezahlukene, futhi lokhu kwakuhle nakweshishini.
Lolu cwaningo luqhathanisa nemiphumela yabanye abacwaningi ababike ukuthi abesifazane abanempumelelo encane yebhizinisi ngenxa yokunakekela ekhaya.
Kunalokho, laba bacwaningi bathi impumelelo yabesifazane abenza ibhizinisi kule ndawo yaseNiger ithonyeka kakhulu yingozi yokuhlaselwa yizigebengu nezihlangu.
Abacwaningi bancoma ukuthi bonke ababambe iqhaza kufanele bahlangane balwe nezinto ezingenza kube nzima ukuphumelela ekuhwebeni.
Ngokwesibonelo, abesifazane baseNiger kufanele bathole ithuba elingcono lokufinyelela ezimali, emapulazini nasekuvikelweni.
Baphinde baphakamisa ukuthi abesifazane abasebenza emabhizinisini bangakha amaqembu azobasiza ekuqaleni nezigebengu nezihlubuki.
Amazinga e-Serum kaMama eSelenium, ithusi neZinki ngesikhathi Sokukhulelwa Ahambisana Nengozi Yokuvela Kokuzelwa Ngaphambi Kwesikhathi: Ucwaningo Lwezimo Ezifanayo oluvela eMalawi
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwamasonto angu-37 agcwele.
Kwenziwe ucwaningo ukuhlola ubudlelwano phakathi kwamazinga e-selenium, ethusi, nezinki e-serum yabamama, nokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Kulolu cwaningo oluhlanganisiwe lwe-case-control, kwakukhona abesifazane abangu-181, abangu-90/181 (49.7%) abakhulelwe isikhathi esigcwele kanye naba ngu-91/181 (50.3%) abakhulelwe isikhathi esingaphelelanga.

Izinga eliphelele le-serum lesileniyamu lalingu-77.0; i-SD 19.4µg/L, ithusi lalingu-2.50; i-SD 0.52 mg/L kanye nezincki lalingu-0.77; i-SD 0.20 mg/L ngamanani ebhekisela angu-47-142µg/L, 0.76-1.59mg/L kanye no-0.59-1.11 mg/L, ngokulandelana.
Imiphumela ibonisa ukuthi kwakungekho ukushoda kwesisileniyamu nezinki; kanye nokuhlushuluka okuphezulu kwe-serum yethusi ekukhulelweni.
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuhlangene namanani aphezulu e-serum ka mama ethusi nezinki.
Amagugu ezinki, ethusi, ne-selenium ahlobene nokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi

Abacwaningi bathole ukugxila okuphezulu kwezinto ezinomsoco odingeka kancane, isileniyamu, umthofi, nezinki, kubesifazane abazalile ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa basaqonda ukuthi lokhu kugxila okuphezulu kuvela ekudleni abakudlayo yini.
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kwenzeka lapho owesifazane ebeletha ingane ingakapheli amasonto angu-37 okukhulelwa.
Ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kuhlotshaniswa nemiphumela emibi yempilo yengane kusukela ebuthakathakeni bokuzalwa kuze kube yokufa.
Kunezizathu eziningi zokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa indima yezingxube eziphakeme zezinto ezinomsoco odingeka kancane ezitholakala ekudleni nasemhlabeni ayaziwa kakhulu.
Lezi zakhamzimba ezidingeka kancane zibalulekile ekukhuleni komntwana, kodwa abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi kwenzekani uma ziningi kakhulu.

Kulesifundo, abacwaningi babeqonde ukulinganisa amazinga esileniyamu, umthofi, nezinki kubesifazane abazalile ngaphambi kwesikhathi, bese beqonde amathuba okuthi ukuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi kubangelwa amazinga aphezulu alowo nalowo umsoco odingeka kancane ocwaningiwe.
Abacwaningi baqoqe amasampula egazi kwabesifazane abangu-181 ngokushesha nje ngemva kokubeletha ezibhedlela ezimbili eLilongwe, inhloko-dolobha yaseMalawi, phakathi kukaJuni 2016 noMashi 2017.
Bathumela amasampula egazi elabhorethri eNorway lapho bakhipha khona i-serum, uhlobo oluhlanzekile lwegazi, balinganise amazinga e-isileniyamu, umthofi nezinki.
Cishe ingxenye yabesifazane abangu-181 ababenesifundo babe nezinsana ezazalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi, futhi abacwaningi bathole amazinga aphezulu kakhulu esileniyamu, umthofi nezinki.

Bese belungisa izibalo zabo ukuze kubhekwe ezinye izici eziningi njengobudala, impilo enhle, kanye nomlando wokukhulelwa ukuze kuvezwe imiphumela eyalindelekile yemisoco edingeka kancane ekubeni khona kokuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi.

Baphetha ngokuthi amazinga aphezulu esileniyamu nethusi awazange adlale indima ebalulekile ekuchazekeni kokuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi, kodwa ukuthi amazinga aphezulu ezinki kwandisa ingozi yokuzala ngaphambi kwesikhathi ngaphezulu kwesikhathi esi-6.
Ubuningi obukhulu bethusi kepha bebuwukukhathazeka kubacwaningi, ngenxa yemiphumela eyingozi eyaaziwayo.

Ukuba nabesifazane abangu-181 kuphela abahlanganyele ocwaningweni kuvimbele ikhono labacwaningi lokufumana ngokufanele ama-riski ahlobene namanqanaba aphezulu e-isileniyamu, njengoba inani elifanele labahahlanganyeli lingu-600.
Ukudla kwansuku zonke kwabahlanganyeli akuphenyiselwanga ukuthola imithombo eminingana yemisoco odingeka kancane, futhi inkomba yesisindo somzimba (BMI) yabo ayirekhodiwe.
Lolu yilona ucwaningo lokuqala lolunjalo olulinganisa imiphumela yesileniyamu, umthofi nezinki kubesifazane abakhulelwe eMalawi.

IAfrika inezinye zezinga eziphezulu kakhulu zokuzalwa ngaphambi kwesikhathi - ngaphezulu kuka-18% uma kuqathaniswa namazwe aseNtshonalanga angu-5%, ngakho-ke abacwaningi bafuna ukwazi ukuthi umsoco udlala indima.
Ukuphatha Kwekhaya, Ukuzinikela Kwendaweni Nokubusa Kwezwe Le-Pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri) eKenya
Izilwane zibonisa ukuziphatha okuhlukile ngokwendawo nangesikhathi okwandisa ukuphila kwazo.
Ukuqonda izenzo ezinjalo kuyisinyathelo esibalulekile sokuvikela nokuphatha kahle ikakhulukazi izinhlobo ezisengozini.

Kulolu cwaningo, sizame ukuhlola ukuthi i-Pancake tortoise inakho yini ikhono lokubuyela ekhaya uma ithuthelwa kwenye indawo, futhi saqala ukuphenya ngokuthembeka kwendawo kanye nobuqhawe balolu hlobo emakhaya alo emvelo eKitui County, eKenya.

Ukuziphatha kwezilwane ezingu-39 zezilwane ezincane ezihlala ezikhaleni zamatshe ezihlukanisiwe ngokwendawo eziyi-12 kwafundwa kusukela ngoJulayi 2020 kuya kuJuni 2022 ngokulandelela ngomsakazo, ukubamba ngekhamera kanye nokuhlanganiswa kokuhlola amasampula eqembu kanye ne-ad libitum sampling.
Ezine (14) zezilwane ezinqolobane zafakwa ama-radio-transmitters, zathuthelwa emapondweni amanye kude namapondwe azo, futhi ukuhamba kwazo nokuziphatha kwazo kwaqashwa.

Ngaphandle kwabesifazane ababili kuphela abazizolise kahle ezikhefini ezintsha zokuthuthela, zonke ezinye izigqikithi zizame ukubuyela ekhaya, nge-46.15% zazo zilandela indlela yazo emuva ezikhefini zasekhaya ngokuqonda okuqondile ne-15.38% zifinyelela nasezindaweni ezikholelwa ukuthi zisezingeni lasekhaya.
Ukuphuma ekhaya okuphumelelayo ngokuqinisekile kubonisa ubuqotho obukhulu bendawonye kule nhlobo.

Uhlalutyo lokugcwaliseka kwemigodi yamasaga lubonise ukuthi bekungekho umehluko obalulekile ngokwezibalo phakathi kwenani lamasaga ayekhona ekuqaleni emigodi nenani eliphakathi nendawo elikhona ezinsukwini ezingama-162 zokuhlola (F(1,22) = 0.0699, P >0.05), okuqhubeka nokusekela ukuthembeka okukhulu kwendawo kule nhlobo.

Ngakolunye uhlangothi, imicimbi yokubamba ngekhamera kanye nokukhetha okukhululekile kwabonisa nokuthi izilwane zasePancake ziyindawo yazo, ngamadoda elwa ngokunamandla ukuvikela izindawo zawo kwabanye amadoda afika.
Izilwane zasehlathini ezi lahlekile zinekhono elimangalisayo lokubuyela "ekhaya".

Abacwaningi benze ukutholakala okumangalisayo ngesikhathi becwaninga ngokuziphatha kwezilwane zaseMpumalanga Afrika ezingama- pancake tortoise (Malacochersus tornieri): lezi zilwane zingakwazi ukuthola indlela yazo yokuphenduka ekhaya ngemva kokuthuthelwa ibanga elide.
Ukuqonda ukuthi benza kanjani lokhu nokuthi kungani benza kanjalo kungaba kubalulekile ekulondolozeni lezi zinyoka ezingavamile.
Ukuziphatha kokufuna ikhaya okubonakaliswa yilezi zikhonkwane kubizwa ngokuthi “ukubuyela ekhaya”, futhi ezinye izilwane eziningi zingakwenza lokho.
Ukukwazi ukubuyela ezindaweni ezithile kuvumela izilwane ukuba zibheke ukudla, izimbangi, nendawo yokuhlala, okwenza kube lula ukuba ziphile futhi zizale.

Nakuba ukuphindeka endlini sekucwaningiwe ezikhonkwane zasolwandle nezasolwandle oluhlanzekile, abacwaningi kule ncwadi bathi sisalwazi kancane ngokuphindeka endlini kwezinkonkwane (ezifanayo nezikhonkwane zasolwandle ezweni).
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuqonda okwengeziwe ngokuziphatha kwezilwane zasehlathini ezingama-pancake tortoise emakhaya azo eKenya, ezindaweni ezinamatshe.
Babafunda izilwane njengoba zihamba zidla, futhi nakuba ziya ekuphumuleni emaphethelweni, noma emaphakathi amadwala.
Abacwaningi babheka amaqembu ezinyoni ze-pancake cishe iminyaka emibili, futhi babekela amakhamera ukuqopha ividiyo yezilwane lapho bengabakheki.
Baphinisela futhi abathumeli bomsakazo kwizilwane ezingu-14 zezilwane.
Lezi yizinto ezincane ezivumela abacwaningi ukuba balandelele ukuhamba kwezilwane, futhi baqaphe ukuthi zichitha isikhathi kuphi emini nasebusuku.
Bese abacwaningi bayisusa amanye ala makhombikhombi endaweni entsha, ukuze bakwazi ukuwafunda kalula.
Kepha, kwakuyisimangaliso kubacwaningi, amaqabunga amabili aqala ukubuyela ezindaweni zawo zokuqala, phakathi kwa-1 no-2.5 km ukusuka lapho ayekhishwe khona.
Yilapho abacwaningi banquma khona ukuzama ukususa izilwane eziningi ekhaya lazo, ukuze babone ukuthi zizobonisa yini ukuziphatha okufanayo "kokubuyela ekhaya".

Ngokuthakazelisayo, cishe ingxenye yeqoqo lezinqolobane zaphumelela ukubuyela emathuneni afanayo ezazihlala kuwo ngaphambi kokuba zihanjiswe, zivame ukuhamba ibanga elingaphezu kwe-1.5 km ukuze zifike lapho.
Abanye abangama-15% bakwazi ukubuyela kuleyo ndawo, kodwa abazange bakuthole ikhefu ababethathiwe kulo ekuqaleni.
Abacwaningi futhi bathole ukuthi amaqhezu ahlukene ngokuvamile ayenani elifanayo lezikhukhula eziphumula kuwo, okubonisa ukuthi izikhukhula zihlala zisebenzisa izindawo ezifanayo ukuphumula.
Izithombe ezivela kumakhamera zikhombise nokuthi izigqwembe ezizinduna zazinendawo yazo, kusho ukuthi zazilwa nezinye izigqwembe ezazifuna ukungena endaweni yazo noma eceleni.

Abacwaningi bathi lokhu kungokokuqala ukuthi kubonwe ukuziphatha kokubuyela ekhaya ezikhonkwane ze-pancake, nokuthi imiphumela yabo ibonisa ukuthi lezi zilwane zikhetha ukuhlala nokupumula ezindaweni ezifanayo noma nini lapho zingakwazi.
Ucwaningo lwabo aluzange luchaze ukuthi izigqirha zaziyithola kanjani indlela yazo emakhaya, ngakho-ke ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekuqondeni leli qophelo elibalulekile.
Ngenxa yokuthi ngezinye izikhathi izilwane kudingeka zisuswe ziye ezindaweni ezintsha ngenxa yokulondolozwa, lolwazi lungasiza abalondolozi ukuba bagcine izigqoko ziphephile endlini yazo entsha.
Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana kososayensi base-Kenya naseShayina, futhi lwenza ulwazi lwethu ngokuziphatha kokubuyela ekhaya kwezilwane ezifana nezinqolobane nezinye izilwane lube ngcono.
Ifarmakhokhinethiki ye-Plasma ye-Rifamisini enkulu ngomlomo ne-ngokwemithambo kubantu abanesifo sofuba sobuchopho:
Ukuhlola Okulawulwayo Okuhleliwe
Amadozi aphezulu e-rifamisini enikezwa ngokwemithambo angathuthukisa imiphumela ekwelapheni isifo sofuba sobuchopho, kodwa awasebenzi kahle ezindaweni ezinezifo eziningi.

Siqagase ukuthi ukukhishwa kwe-rifamisini yeplasma kuzofanana phakathi kokunisela ngomlomo kwama-35 mg/kg wesisindo somzimba kanye nokudla ngokwemithambo yama-20 mg/kg, okuye kwaphakanyiswa ukuhlolwa kokusebenzakahle kwe- meningitis ye-tuberculous.
Senze ucwaningo lwe-pharmacokinetic oluhleliwe lwamaqembu alinganayo olufakwe ngaphakathi kokuhlola okungokwelapha kokwelashwa okukhulu kwe-antimicrobial yesifo sofuba sengqondo.
Abahlanganyeli abane-HIV abanesifo sofuba sobuchopho baqokwa emagulini aseNingizimu Afrika, bahlukaniswe ngamaqembu amathathu okunikezwa kwe-rifampisini:
esinye (ngomlomo 10 mg/kg), esiphezulu (ngomlomo 35 mg/kg), kanye ne-ngokwemithambo (20 mg/kg).
Ukuqoqwa okukhulu kwe-pharmacokinetic kwenziwe ngosuku lwesithathu.
Ulwazi luchazwe kusetshenziswa ukuhlaziya okungekho ngamagumbi, futhi ukukhishwa kuqhathaniswe ngezilinganiso ze-geometric mean (GMRs).
Abahambi abangamashumi amane nesithupha baphathwa ukukhethwa kwe-pharmacokinetic (umthamo ojwayelekile, n = 17; umthamo ophezulu ngomlomo, n = 15; ngokwemithambo, n = 14).
Izinga eliphakathi le-CD4 lalingu-130 amaseli/mm3 (ububanzi phakathi kwekota [IQR], angu-66 kuya kwangu-253 amaseli/mm3).

Izindinganiso ze-rifamisini ze-geometric mean area under the concentration-time curve kusukela ku-0 kuya ku-24 h (AUC0–24) zazingu-42.9mg · h/ml (isikhathi sokuqiniseka se-95% [CI], 24.5 kuya ku-75.0mg ·h/ml) ngenani elijwayelekile, 295.2mg · h/ml (isikhathi sokuqiniseka se-95% [CI], 189.9 kuya ku-458.8mg · h/ml) ngenani eliphezulu lomlomo, kanye no-206.5mg · h/ml (isikhathi sokuqiniseka se-95% [CI], 154.6 kuya ku-275.8mg · h/ml) ngokuphathwa ngokwemithambo.

I-rifamisini AUC0–24 GMR yayingu-1.44 (90% CI, 0.84 kuya ku-2.21) kanti ukugxila okuphezulu kwezidakamizwa e-serum (Cmax) GMR kwakungu-0.89 (90% CI, 0.63 kuya ku-1.23) ngokuphathelene nokuphathwa kwezidakamizwa ngokwemithambo.

I-AUC0–24 yerifamisini yeplasma yayiphezulu ngemva kokuthatha umthamo wemlomo ongu-35 mg/kg kunokunikezwa ngokwemithambo ngomthamo ongu-20 mg/kg ezinsukwini ezimbalwa zokuqala zokwelapha isifo sofuba (TB).
Okutholakele kusekela ukunikezwa kwemithi yomlomo ye-rifamisini ekuhlolweni kwe-meningitis ye-tuberculous kwesikhathi esizayo.
Amaphilisi aphezulu kakhulu angahlolwa kubantu abane-HIV abanesifo sofuba sobuchopho.
Abacwaningi baye baqinisekisa ukuthi kubalulekile ukuqala ukuhlola ukuthi izilinganiso eziphezulu zomuthi irifamisini zingabasindisa yini iziguli ze-HIV ezine-ingqimba yesifo sofuba.
Kufika kwaba-3 kwaba-5 abantu abane-HIV abaphathwa yi-meningitis ye-TB abafa ngenxa yalesi sifo, esihlasela uhlelo lwezinzwa.
Abasindile bavame ukushiywa benenkinga ehlala njalo ehlelweni lwezinzwa elikhulu nezinzwa ezibalulekile ezivela ebuchosheni.
Lokhu kungathinta imizwelo yabo nokuhamba kwabo.
Abanye abagulayo baquleka noma bahlushwa yisisu, noma ingxenye yobuso babo noma umzimba wabo ikhubazeka.
IRifamisini, umuthi oqine kakhulu oluwa namagciwane olusetshenziswa ekulweni nesifo sofuba, ngokuvamile unikezwa ngama-capsules ukuzama ukubulala amagciwane abangela isifo sofuba sobuchopho.
Iziguli ezigula kakhulu zivame ukuthola ukuthi izitho zinzima ukuziluma.
I-Rifamisini ingaphinda inikezwe ngokwemithambo (emithanjeni) ngesimo esilukhuni.
Khona-ke, kunaliti efakwa emithanjeni yesiguli ukuze uketshezi kukwazi ukukhishwa emzimbeni.
Akukaqalwa luhlolo lokuthola ukuthi umzimba wesiguli uyayithatha kanjani imithi uma le ndlela isebenza.
Ukwelashwa ngokwemithambo kudinga imishini eminingi, ukungena esibhedlela nomsebenzi wezempilo oqeqeshwe owazi ukuthi angawufaka kanjani umbethelwana wemithambo ngendlela efanele.
Ngakho-ke akuyona indlela eqondile ezindaweni zezwe ezinomkhawulo wezinsiza.
Odokotela sebevele bayazi ukuthi irifamisini ayithathwa kahle yi-fluid ebuchosheni, e-spine nasekhanda, lapho amabhaktheriya angafihla khona.
Yingakho kudingeka amazinga aphezulu (amanani) ukuze kubulawe ngempumelelo wonke amagciwane emzimbeni wesiguli.
Kodwa abacwaningi babengakaqiniseki ukuthi umthamo ophakeme kangakanani ungasebenza futhi ube yilona elinokuphepha.

Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika nase-United Kingdom ngaleyondlela bafuna ukuthola, besebenzisa inani elincane lezaguligugu, ukuthi kuphephile yini ukunikeza imithamo ephakeme ye-rifamisini noma njengekhapsuli noma ngokwemithambo, nokuthi imizimba yabo izoyithatha kanjani inguqulo ngayinye.
Kubalulekile ukwazi lokhu ngaphambi kokuba abanye abacwaningi baqale ngokuzama okukhulu, noma ukuhlola, lapho becabanga ukuhlinzeka iziguli eziningi ngamathani aphezulu e-rifamisini.
Enye yezinhlobo ezintathu zokwelashwa nge-rifamisini yanikezwa iziguli zaseNingizimu Afrika ezingama-46 ezine-HIV ezinesifo sofuba sobuchopho.
Eyokuqala kwakuwukwelashwa okujwayelekile kwamakhapsili anikezwa iziguli okwamanje, ahlanganisa i-10mg ye-rifamisini ngekhilogremu ngayinye isisindo somguli.
Enye iqembu lithole amaphilisi omthamo ophezulu angu-35 milligrams ngekhilogremu yesisindo sesiguli.
Iqembu lesithathu lamukela ama-milligrams angamashumi amabili ngekhilogremu yesisindo somuntu ngokwemithambo.
Amasampuli egazi athathwe kubagulayo ngemva kwezinsuku ezintathu.
Abacwaningi babe sebeyalela ukuthi kukhona kangakanani irifamisini ekuketshezi lwegazi (ingxenye eyi-liquid yegazi).
Kwatholakala irifamisini eminingi emizimbeni yeziguli ezithole ama-capsules amakhulu kunalabo abaphathwe ngokwemithambo noma abatholé umthamo ojwayelekile.
Ubuningi bomuthi e-plasma yegazi babuhlangana ngokwelashwa okuphezulu kanye nokwelashwa ngokwemithambo.
Lezi zingxube zaziyinkulu kunezikhathi lapho iziguli zithola kuphela umthamo ojwayelekile.
Ngokusho kwabacwaningi, lokhu kubonisa ukuthi impilo yeziguli ezine-meningitis yesifo sofuba ingathuthukiswa uma zithola imithamo emikhulu ye-rifamisini.
Akuyona into ebalulekile ukuthi bayithola njengezithocoli noma ngokwemithambo - okubalulekile ukuthi bathole imithamo ephakeme, ngoba imizimba yabo iyokwazi ukugcina ukugxila okuphezulu kwalo.
Imiphumela isekela imiphumela yokuhlola okwenziwe e-Uganda nase-Indonesia.
Ukuhlola okuncane okubili e-Indonesia, ngokwesibonelo, kusikisela ukuthi izimpilo zeziguli eziningi zingasindiswa uma zithola imithamo emikhulu ye-rifamisini ngokomlomo noma ngokwemithambo.
Kodwa-ke, ngokudabukisayo, abacwaningi baxwayisa ngokuthi ababambiqhaza abambalwa abaye baba yingxenye yalesi sifundo kunalokho ababekuqale bekuthanda, okungenzeka ukuthi kulimala imiphumela yabo.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe eNingizimu Afrika.
Kusekela uhlelo lokuqhuba ukuhlola ukuhlola ukuthi kuwufanele yini ukunika iziguli ze-HIV ezine-meningitis yesifo sofuba imithamo emikhulu ye-rifamisini.
Kulindeleke ukuthi ukwelashwa okunjalo kuzosindisa izimpilo eziningi zabantu e-Afrika nakwezinye izindawo emhlabeni lapho isifo sofuba sobuchopho kuyinkinga enkulu.
Ukusetshenziswa komquba nelahlemlotha ndawonye kungayithuthukisa yini ikhwalithi yomhlabathi ogugile kakhulu wasehlathini laselwandle?
Ukuncipha kokuvunda komhlabathi kuyinkinga enkulu ekukhiqizweni kwezitshalo e-zansi nesahara Afrika.
Umnkantsha omuhle wokusetshenziswa kwe-ilahlemlotha ne-umquba ekuvundiseni komhlabathi ubikezelwe ngababhali abaningi.

Kulesi sifundo, kwakukhona i-incubation yesikhathi esingama-30-days laboratory esenziwe ngamasampula angu-120 g ngalinye le-Haplic acrisol ehlanganiswe ne-corn cob biochar (cbio), i-rice husk biochar (rbio), i-coconut husk biochar (coco300 ne coco700) noma umquba womquba wezinkukhu (umquba); kanye ne-co-composted rice husk biochar (rcocomp) noma i-co-composted corn cob biochar (cococomp) ngezilinganiso ze-1% w/w amendment: umhlaba, ngokulandelana.

Ezinye izindlela zokwelapha ekutadishweni kwakuyi-compost yomquba wezinkukhu ehlanganisiwe ne-biochar yommbila noma i-biochar yehusk yorayisi (1% compost + 1% biochar: 1% umhlaba w/w), ngokulandelana, ukuhlola imiphumela yazo ekuphefumuleni komhlaba, i-pH yomhlaba; ikhabhoni ye-microbial yomhlaba; ikhono lokushintshana kwama-cation; ikhabhoni ephelele ephilayo, i-nitrogen ephelele kanye nokuhlangana kwe-nitrogen okutholakalayo.
I-biochar nomquba owasetshenziswa wedwa noma ndawonye, ne-biochar ehlanganisiwe, kwandisa i-pH yomhlabathi ngamayunithi e-pH angu-0.28–2.29 uma kuqathaniswa nokulawula okungagciniwe.

Ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo okuvela kumquba wodwa noma umquba wehusk yorayisi, noma i-biochar yekhobho yekhowuni noma i-biochar ne-compost ehlangene kwakuphezulu kunokulawula okungagciniwe, okwakufana nokuphathwa yi-biochar kuphela.
I-TOC emqubeni wedwa nasekuphatheni okuhlanganisiwe kwe-biochar yommbila kanye nomquba yayiphezulu nge-37% ne-117%, ngokulandelana, kunokulawula.
Ukusetshenziswa ndawonye kwe-biochar yehusk yorayisi nomquba kwandisa i-MBC nge-132% kuyilapho ukwengezwa komquba wodwa kwandisa i-MBC nge-247%, uma kuqhathaniswa nokulawula.

Ngamafuphi, ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi ukusetshenziswa kodwa noma okuhlangene komquba ne-ilahlemlotha, noma i-ilahlemlotha ehlanganisiwe, kuye kwathuthukisa imingcele yeqophelo lenhlabathi njenge-pH yomhlabathi ne-MBC, futhi kuthuthukise ukuzinza kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuthuthukiswa kwe-TOC nokunciphisa ukulahleka kwe-C yomhlabathi ngokuphefumula okuyisisekelo.
Ilahlemlotha nomquba zithuthukisa iqophelo lenhlabathi lezizitshalo.

Lolu cwaningo luhlole ukuthi ilahlemlotha, into eqinile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, eyenziwe ngezinto eziwumquba, ingasetshenziswa kanjani ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi e-Afrika yasezansi nesahara.
Ucwaningo olutholile ukuthi ilahlemlotha ilungisa ikhwalithi yomhlaba ngendlela efanayo nezinye izindlela ezingabizi kakhulu futhi ezingatholakali kalula.
Esinye sezinkinga ezinkulu eziqala ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo e-zansi nesahara yi-Afrika ukuwohloka kokuvunda komhlabathi.
Iqophelo lenhlabathi elihle lingaletha izivuno zezitshalo ezingcono, okuzokunciphisa ubumpofu basemakhaya futhi kuphendule ukubola kwemithombo yemvelo.
Ucwaningo lubonise ukuthi ilahlemlotha, into eqinile kakhulu, ecebile ngekhabhoni, ingasetshenziswa ukuthuthukisa ukukhula komhlaba.
Ilahlemlotha / i-biochar iyimikhiqizo evela ekushiseni izinto eziphilayo, noma i-biomass, ngokuba khona koksijini okuncane noma okungekho.
Kuye kwabonakala ukuthi i-biochar iyakwandisa indawo ebonakalayo yomhlaba, ikhulise ukufinyeleleka kwamanzi nomoya, futhi isebenze izilwanyana ezincani emhlabathini.

Ucwaningo lolu luhlolwe umphumela we-biochar ne-compost ekulinganisweni komhlaba usebenzisa izinkomba ezinjengokuphefumula komhlaba, i-pH yomhlaba, ukuba khona kwamagciwane, inani lekhaboni, kanye nenani lenayithrojeni elikhona.
Abacwaningi bakhiqize i-biochar yamasiko ommbila, i-coconut nehusk yorayisi besebenzisa i-pyrolysis, okuhilela ukushisa izinto eziphilayo ngaphandle koksijini, ku-450 °C esitofu esenziwe endaweni.
Abacwaningi bakhiqiza i-biochar yeziqongo zeziqu zekhokhothi bebenza i-pyrolysis ku-300 °C naku-700 °C.
Bese abacwaningi bahlanganisa amasampula omhlaba ahlanganiswe ne-biochar izinsuku ezingu-30.

Isampula ngayinye yayinawo umhlabathi okhethekile olungisiwe okuthiwa yi-Haplic acrisol, owakuhlanganiswe nezinhlanganisela ezahlukene ze-biochar ezenziwe nge-corn cob, i-rice husk noma i-coconut husk, kanye nomquba wezinkukhu.
Amanye amasampula ayesinezimpahla ezihlanganisiwe zomhlaba nomquba wezinkukhu, ne-biochar yokuhlwanyela irayisi, ne-biochar yokuhlwanyela i-corn cob, ngokulandelana.
Isampula ngayinye yayina-1% yomquba, i-1% yilahleml otha ngayinye, ukuze abacwaningi bakwazi ukuhlola umphumela wokuhlanganiswa ngakunye ekulinganisweni lomhlaba.

Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi ukufaka ilahlemlotha nomquba emhlabathini, ngokwahlukana noma ndawonye, kwandisa izinga le-pH lomhlabathi kusuka ku-0.28–2.29 ama-yunithi e-pH, uma kuqathaniswa nomhlabathi ongaxubiwanga.
Ukukhula kwe-pH kusho ukuthi inhlabathi yaba mancane ukuba namanzi.

Ucwaningo oluthole ukuthi ukuphefumula okuyisisekelo, noma inani elincane le-carbon dioxide ekhishwa yinhlabathi, likhuphuke lapho umquba wedwa ufakwe, noma lapho umquba uhlanganiswe neqanda lerayisi, noma i-biochar yeqanda le-corn, noma i-biochar ehlanganisiwe.
Amasampula omhlaba abonise ukwanda kokuqukethwe okuhlanganisiwe kwe-carbon engu-37% lapho kusetshenziswa umquba wodwa, nokukhuphuka okungu-117% lapho i-biochar yomsila wekhabhisi ixutshwe nomquba.

Inani lomsebenzi wama-microorganism landa ngamaphesenti angu-132 lapho umhlaba wawunahlanganisela lomquba ne-biochar yokuhlutha irayisi, uma kuqathaniswa nokukhula kwamaphesenti angu-247 emasampuleni omhlaba ayenomquba wodwa.
Imiphumela yalo ucwaningo ikhombisa ukuthi kungenzeka ukunciphisa ukubanda komhlaba usebenzisa ilahlemlotha, etholakala kalula futhi ngokubiza okuphansi.
Lokhu kuhlukile endleleni ehlukile yokufaka ilayimu emhlabathini, okuyindleko enkulu futhi akunakutholakala kalula kubalimi abancane base-Afrika ezansi nesahara.
I-Network Engaqondakali Ye-Fibrin Fibre Esifoneni Samathambo Nokuxhumana Kwayo Nokungatheleleki, Ukuvuvukala Ne-Thrombosis
Ubungozi bezigameko zenhliziyo kubantu abane-RA bukhulu kakhulu ngenxa yokuvuvukala komzimba jikelele.
Umphumela ophambene wokuchibilakala okuhlobene nezifo ezihlasela amasosha omzimba ekwakhekeni nasemandleni okwenza i-thrombosis ye-fibrin(ogen) awukaziwa.

Ngakho-ke saqhathanisa izilinganiso zomsebenzi wezinsimbi zegazi, ukuvuvukala, ukuhlanganiswa kwegazi kanye nokuhlanganiswa kwe-fibrin clot kubantu abane-RA kanye neziguli ezinempilo, saqhathanisa nobudlelwano phakathi kwalezi zilinganiso.
Kwathathwa amasampuli egazi kwiziguli ze-RA ezingama-30 kanye nabazinikele abaphilile abangama-25 abalingana ngobudala nobulili.
Amazinga e-SAA, i-CRP, i-ICAM-1 ne-VCAM-1 ayalinganiswa kusetshenziswa i-sandwich immunoassay.
Ukuhlanganiswa kwegazi lonke kuhlolwe kusetshenziswa i-Thromboelastography.
Imininingwane yenethiwekhi ye-fibrin clot kanye nesakhiwo sefayibha kuhlolwe nge-Scanning Electron Microscopy.
Ukutholwa nokulinganiswa kwe-citrullination ezigangeni ze-fibrin ezakhiwe kwenziwe kusetshenziswa i-antibody ye-Citrulline enombala olukhanyayo nge-Confocal Microscopy.
Amazinga e-SAA, i-CRP ne-ICAM-1 aphakame kakhulu kubantu abane-RA uma kuqathaniswa neqembu lokuqhathanisa.
Imingcele ye-TEG ehambisana nokuqala kokugandeka kwegazi (R ne-K), izinga lokuxhumana kwe-fibrin (i-α-Angle), nesikhathi sokuthola ukukhiqizwa okukhulu kwe-thrombus (TMRTG) beyehla ezigulini ze-RA.
Imingcele emayelana namandla e-clot (MA, MRTG, TGG) ayizange ihluke ngokwezibalo phakathi kwe-RA namaqembu okulawula.

Ukusebenza kwe-indlela yokuhlaziya izibalo yokubikezela umphumela kanambambili kwembula ukuhlotshaniswa okukhulu phakathi kwe-acute phase reactants (CRP, SAA) nemingcele ye-TEG kunamamaki wokusebenza kwe-endothelial.

Ukuhlaziywa nge-mayikroskhopu kwembule izinhlanganisela ezinzima zefayibha zefayibhrini ezinzima kubantu abane-RA uma kuqathaniswa nokulawula [i-median (i-interquartile range) 214 (170-285) vs 120 (100-144) nm ngokulandelana, p<0.0001, i-Odds ratio=22.7).
Ukubona izindawo eziningi ezicitrrullinated ngaphakathi kwemizimba ye-fibrin clot kubantu abane-RA, okwakuncane kakhulu emasampulini okulawula (p<0.05, OR=2.2).
Iziguli ezine-RA esebenzayo zibonisa iphrofayili yokugqwala igazi engalingani nemibono ejwayelekile ehambisana nezinye izimo zokuvuvukala.

Ukuguqulwa kokwakheka kwamaprotheni okuhambisana nokuhlanganiswa kwama-citrullination okubangelwa amasosha omzimba kungase kudlale indima ekuqondeni ubukhulu be-fibrin kanye nethuba lokukhulisa ingozi ye-thrombotic kubantu abane-RA.
Ukujiya kwegazi kubantu abane-arthritis kungachaza ingozi yabo enkulu yokuba nesifo senhliziyo, isifo sobuchopho.
Ucwaningo olusha ngesifo samathambo luye lwanikeza ukuqonda okungcono ngokuxhumana okungenzeka phakathi kwalesi simo nengozi enkulu yesifo senhliziyo.
Isifo samathambo (RA) yisimo esibuhlungu nesiphazamisayo samasosha omzimba, esihambisana nokuvuvukala kwamajoyini nakho konke umzimba.

Sekuyisikhathi eside manje, ososayensi bayazi ukuthi labo abane lesifo banesilinganiso esiphezulu sezingozi ze-50% zemiphumela yesifo senhliziyo nemithambo yegazi (CVD) – njengokuqhaqhazela noma ukuhlaselwa yinhliziyo.
Iphuzu eliyisihluthulelo kulowo mngcipheko iwukuthi ukuvuvukala kuthinta kanjani inqubo yokujiya kwegazi.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bahlolisise lobu budlelwano, ukuze bathole ukuthi kungani ngempela i-RA ikhuphula ubungozi be-CVD.
Ngokuqondile, abacwaningi bahlole imiphumela yokuvuvukala nezinguquko zesakhiwo kumaprotheni athile ahlobene nokuqina kwegazi, abizwa ngokuthi amafibrin.

La maprotheni avela njengezintambo ezinde ezakha “umsebenzi” oyisisekelo weziqephu zegazi, ngakho noma yiziphi izinguquko kumafibrin ngokwabo zingaba nemiphumela emibi ekuqinisweni kwegazi ngokujwayelekile.
Abacwaningi baqhathanise amasampuli egazi eziguli ze-RA namasampuli abantu abaphilile.
Kuzo zonke izimo, abacwaningi babefuna “amamaka” egazini abonisa ukuvuvukala, kanye nanoma yiziphi izinguquko ezingavamile ekuhlanganiseni kwegazi okuvamile okungandisa ingozi ye-CVD.
Ama-clots ngokwawo aphinde ahlolwa nge-microscope, ukuze kubonwe noma yiziphi izinguquko esakhiweni samaprotheni abo e-fibrin.

Abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi ama-clots ezigulini ezine-RA akha ngokushesha kunalabo abantu abaphilile, futhi ukuthi izinhlanganisela zamaprotheni azenziwe nawo ziziqatha kakhulu kunama-fibrins avamile.
Kwakukhona nezinguquko ezakhamzimbeni ezenza amaprotheni e-fibrin, okwenza aqalise impendulo yokulwa nezifo yomzimba, okubangele ukuvuvukala okwengeziwe.

Abanye abacwaningi baye baphawula izinguquko esakhiweni se-amino acid yama-fibrins ezinhlangothini zeziguli ze-RA ngaphambili, kodwa lokhu kuyisikhathi sokuqala abacwaningi bebona umphumela ofanayo egazini.

Uma kuhlanganiswa nezinye izinguquko ezibonwe emagagini egazi, lokho okutholwe kungasiza ososayensi ukuthi baqonde kangcono ubuhlobo phakathi kwe-RA ne-CVD, nokuthi ungabona kanjani izimpawu zokuqala zalezi zifo.
Nakuba le miphumela yokuqala ithembisa, kufanele kuqapheleke ukuthi usayizi wesampula yocwaningo wawuncane ngokulinganisa.

Abacwaningi baphinda bakhuluma ngokuthi indlela abayisebenzisile ukuthola izinguquko ze-amino acid kumaprotheni nayo ingase ithole imiphumela evela ezintweni ezingahambi kahle, kusho ukuthi kuzodingeka ukuhlolwa okuqondiwe okuqondene ne-fibrins ukuqinisekisa umphumela esikhathini esizayo.

Ngokuhamba kwesikhathi, ukuqonda ubudlelwano obuyingozi phakathi kwe-RA nokunyuka komngcipheko we-CVD kungathuthukisa imiphumela kubantu abane-RA njengoba sifunda ukubona nokuphatha lezi zifo ngokuphumelelayo.
Abacwaningi baseNingizimu Afrika, eDenmark nase-United Kingdom bahlanganyele kulesi cwaningo, esixhaswe yiSouth African Medical Research Council.
Izibikezelo zezimo zezulu zasemanzini zabasebenzisi bolwandle lwasemgwaqweni – ukuqonda, ukusebenziseka nokusetshenziswa.
Ucwaningo olukhona luqonde ukulungisa ukungafani phakathi kwesayensi nomphakathi ngendlela yokungafani okungenzeka ekunikezeni nasekufuneni kolwazi okwaziwa njengesikhala sokusetshenziswa.
Kulesi simo, sihlola ukubaluleka kolwazi lwemithoshini njengoba kubonakala ngabasebenzisi emazweni amabili eNingizimu Hemisphere:
INingizimu Afrika neNyuzilani.
Lapha, ukugxila akuyona kuphela emibonweni, ukusetshenziswa nokusetshenziswa kwezibikezelo zezinhlekelele, kodwa kunokugxila ekusebenzelaneni okuvamile, okujwayelekile kwezibikezelo.
Ucwaningo lwenziwe ngenhlolovo, eyenzelwe imibuzo yokucwaninga emithathu.

Imibuzo yocwaningo ihlanganisa izihloko ezihlukahlukene kusukela ekusebenzeni kalula kwemishini yokubikezela, ukunemba nokuhambisana, ukusebenziseka, idumela lezikhungo, kanye nokungabaza okuhlobene nenguquko yobunjalozwe (okumbalwa nje).
Umbhalomibuzo waku-inthanethi wasabalaliswa kabanzi ukuze ufake abasebenzisi abangokuzijabulisa nabangokurhweba.
Ucwaningo luye lwasekela ekubeni atholakale amasiko okwenza izinqumo angase abe khona anezibonakaliso ezihlukile eziqondene nezidingo zolwazi lwabasebenzisi bolwandle lwasemgwaqeni.

Ukuhlaziya kokuvumelana kwamasiko (CCA) kusetshenziswe ukuphenya ukuqonda okuhlanganyelwe kanye nokuhlukahluka kokubona phakathi kweqembu elikhulu labaphenduli kanye nasemaqenjini angaphansi ezizinda nasemazweni.
Sithole amazinga ahlukahlukene okuvumelana eqenjini lonke (abantu abavela kuwo womabili amazwe kanye nazo zonke izigaba zihlangene) uma kuqhathaniswa namaqembu ahlukene abasebenzisi.

Bonke ababambiqhaza, uma behlanganiswe, babonisa ukuvumelana okuvamile ngokwesiko mayelana nezindaba ezazibekwe, kodwa ngezinye izinguquko zemibono ezingeni lezizwe, okubonisa ukuthi kungenzeka kube khona amasiko aphansi.

Uma sihlalutya amaqembu ahlukene ezizwe nasekhefini ngokwahlukana, sathola ukuvumelana okuhambisanayo kakhulu komoya wesiko eqenjini labasebenzisi baseNingizimu Afrika, ngokuvumelana okukhulu kungakhathaliseki ukuhlanganyela kwezifunda.
Iqembu labasebenzisi bezohwebo base-New Zealand liye labonisa ukubambisana okubuhlungu kakhulu nakho konke amanye amaqembu aphansi.
Siyaxoxa ngemiphumela evela kwimigomo yethu ezintweni ezibalulekile ekutholeni izinsizakalo ngakho-ke ekukhiqizweni kwezibikezelo ezibalulekile.
Kukhulunywe nezinye izinto ezihamba phambili zokubikezela okuqondene nesayensi esikhathini esizayo, kubhekwa imiphumela yenguquko yobunjalozwe elindelekile.
Siphetha ngokuncoma umdwebo oqondakalayo ukuze kugqamise ukusebenzisana okubalulekile phakathi kokubambisana ekukhiqizeni iziprognosi nokunambitheka/ukuhambisana kwezesayensi.
AbaseNingizimu Afrika, abaseNew Zealand bathemba izibikezelo zezulu olwandle

AbaseNingizimu Afrika nabaseNew Zealand abasebenza futhi abahlala emagqumeni bathembele ezinsizakalweni zezibikezelo zesimo sezulu ezilula ukuzisebenzisa, futhi ezihlale zinikeza izibikezelo ezinembile.
Izinsizakalo zezibikezelo zezwe lonke namawebhusayithi ahlukahlukene ezohwebo zinikeza izibikezelo mayelana nokuthi isimo sezulu sizoba yini.
Bayazama ukuba nenemba futhi asebenziseke ngangokunokwenzeka.
Isayensi enkulu kanye nokucabanga okwesayensi kungenela eziqagulweni.

Kulolu cwaningo abacwaningi bakhetha ukubheka indlela abantu baseNingizimu Afrika naseNew Zealand abasebenzisa ngayo izinsizakalo zokubikezela – womabili amazwe anamahlathi amade, kodwa anabantu bendawo abaningi abahlukene nezimimo zasemahlathi.

Bebefuna ukuthola ukuthi kangakanani laba bantu basemgwaqeni belwandle basebenzisa izinsizakalo zokubikezela zezwe noma zezohwebo, ngaziphi izinjongo nokuthi ngabe bazithole ziwusizo futhi zinethemba yini.
Lezi yizici ezibalulekile uma kubhekwa ukuthi inguquko yobunjalozwe yesikhathi esizayo ingathinta kanjani ukuqagula isimo sezulu.
Imibuzo eku-inthanethi iphendulwe ngama-South Afrika angu-31 nama-New Zealander angu-126.

Lokhu kuhlanganisa abantu abasebenzisa izibikezelo zesimo sezulu ngenxa yemisebenzi yabo (isibonelo abalobi nezinhlangano zokusesha nokusindisa), nabanye ababamba iqhaza emidlalweni ehlangene nolwandle nemisebenzi yokuphumula njengokuntweza, ukuchofoza, noma ukubhukuda.
Abacwaningi babuza ngokuthi kulula kangakanani ukusebenzisa isevisi yokubikezela isimo sezulu abayikhethile, nokuthi ukubikezela kwayo kwakunembile futhi kuqondile kangakanani.
Ababambiqhaza baluhlu lwezinto ezenza lwaba luncedo futhi lubaluleke kubo, bathi uma lokhu kungase kushintshe ngenxa yenguquko yobunjalozwe.
Kumelwe bathi futhi ukuthi bayethemba yini ulwazi oluvela ezikhungweni zezulu zasezweni labo, nokuthi bazizwa kanjani ngalo.
Iningi labantu baseNingizimu Afrika abahlanganyele kulolu cwaningo babengabagibeli bezeqe, noma abantu abasiza emisebenzini yokusesha nokukhulula noma eziprojekthini zocwaningo.
Abaningi baseNew Zealand abaphendule imibuzo babukele izibikezelo zezulu ngoba babefuna ukuya ukudoba, ukuqhuba isikebhe noma ukuhamba ngomkhumbi olwandle.
Ababambiqhaza bevela kuwo omabili amazwe bathemba ulwazi abaluphiwe yi-National Weather Services yabo.
Babethanda izinsizakalo zokubikezela ezinembayo, ezihlala zifanayo, ezilula ukuzisebenzisa futhi ezinemiklamo engaguqulwa ukuze ihambisane nezidingo zabo.
Abantu ababelisebenzisa le nsizakalo ngenhloso yemisebenzi ngokuvamile bathole ukuthi izibikezelo zezimo zasebeni eliseduze komkhumbi zazingekho nembile ngokwanele.
Ulwazi lweminye imiphakathi lwalunembile kunolweminye.
AbaseNingizimu Afrika babethanda ukusebenzisa izinsizakalo zezulu kakhulu kunabaseNew Zealand, futhi babebukele okungenani kanye ngosuku.
Kubaphenduli abangu-9 kwaba-10, uhlelo oluhle kakhulu lokubikezela lwalubaluleke kakhulu.
Abaningi bakhetha isevisi eyayinika ukubuka kusukela ezinsukwini ezintathu kuya kweziyisikhombisa ezizayo.
Abantu abasebenza ezolimeni zamanzi noma ababefanele bahlele ngezimo ezingenzeka eziphuthumayo bafuna izibikezelo zesikhathi eside nezesizini.

Abasebenzisi abaningi bakholelwa ukuthi ngenxa yokwanda kwenguquko yobunjalozwe, izinsizakalo zokubikezela kuzofanele zisebenzise ulwazi olusekelwe esayensi oluhle nakakhulu esikhathini esizayo ukuqinisekisa ukuqagula okuqondile.
Izifundo ezimbalwa kakhulu ezinjalo ezenziwe ngaphambili emazweni aseNingizimu Hemisphere.
Abacwaningi bathemba ukuthi bakwazile ukufunda okwanele kubabambiqhaza ngemibuzo abababuze yona.
Omunye ubuthakathaka obunokuba khona yikuthi abantu abaningi abahlala eNew Zealand kunaseNingizimu Afrika bahlanganyele kulolu cwaningo.
Umsebenzi wabo uzosiza abantu abasebenza ezinsizakalweni zokubikezela isimo sezulu ukwakha imikhiqizo engcono ecabanga ngezidingo zamakhasimende abo.
Bayokwazi ukwenza uthuthuko kanye nezinguquko ngokusekelwe ekuqondeni ukuthi amaklayenti abo anelisekile kangakanani nokuthi kungani bewasebenzisa.
