Umqondo we-Climate-smart agriculture (CSA) uyaqina emhlabeni jikelele.
Kodwa-ke, aliqondile ngalokho okufanele kufakwe phansi kwezinsika ezintathu zalo—ukukhiqiza, amandla okuvuka uzibuthe, nokunciphisa.
Ngenxa yalokho, i-CSA ihlanganisa izindlela/izinkambiso ezahlukene zezolimo, okwenza kube nzima ukuqondisa imigomo ye-CSA.
Okokuqala, kunesidingo sokuqina nokusebenza kwemigomo kanye nezindlela zokuhlola ukusebenza kahle kwezimo zezulu zokungenelela.
Okwesibili, kunolwazi oluncane olukhona mayelana nethonya lokungenelela okuhlukahlukene okusekuqalisiwe njenge-CSA, ikakhulukazi emhlabeni osathuthuka.
Ekugcineni, ukukhethwa kwe-CSA akucabangi izimbono zababambe iqhaza ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukungenelela kufanelekele, kufanelekile futhi kunamandla okwamukelwa aphezulu.
Lapha, sichaza iprotokholu entsha ehlanganyelwe yokulinganisa ubuhlakaniphi besimo sezulu bokungenelela kwezolimo emikhubeni yabalimi abancinyane.
Lokhu kuqopha izinkomba (nezinqamuleli) zezinga lefama zezinsika ze-CSA zokutholakala kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
Iphinde isekela ukulinganiswa kokubamba iqhaza kwezinkomba, okuvumela ukwenziwa kokuhlolwa kwesisekelo nokukuhlolwa kwesikhathi esizayo sokuhlakanipha kwesimo sezulu.
Le phrotokoli livivinywe phakathi kwalimi abangu-72 abasebenzisa izinhlobo ezihlukahlukene zokungenelela kwe-CSA eLushoto, eTanzania, eyihlala ekulima okuhlakaniphile.

Ikakhulukazi abalimi babeqakathekisa ukungenelela okwakuthuthukisa ukukhula komhlabathi nesakhiwo sawo, kunciphisa ukugeleza kwamanzi, futhi kubuyisele umhlabathi owohlokile ngenxa yemiphumela emihle esivunweni naselimeni lempahla yasezinyangeni zasebusika.
Ngokuyinhloko, ukungenelela kwe-CSA kwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwezilwane, ukukhiqizwa kokudla, ukusetshenziswa kanye nemali engenayo.
Iprotokholu kulula ukuyenza ifanelane nezindawo ezihlukene nezinhlelo zokulima futhi ivumela ukuqondiswa kangcono kokungenelela.
Kepha sincoma ukuthi i-CSA yamukelwe njengengxenye yenqubo yokubeka iliso, ukuhlola nokufunda.
Amathekhniqi amasha okuqapha asisiza ososayensi nabalimi ukuba balungiselele inguquko yobunjalozwe.
Ososayensi abasebenza nabalimi eThanzaniya manje bangalinganisa ukuthi imikhuba emisha yokuhlwayela isebenza kangakanani ekuqedeni imiphumela yenguquko yobunjalozwe.
Bathemba ukuthi indlela yabo izokuthuthukisa ukutholakala kokudla kanye nezovuno zezitshalo kubalimi nakwezinye izingxenye zezwe.
“Ukulima okuhlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu” kuyinto u-United Nations ayikhuthaza ukusiza abalimi abancinyane ukuba balungiselele inguquko yobunjalozwe.
Umlimi ohlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu uyazivumelanisa nezimo zezulu ezishintshayo futhi uyakwazi ukwandisa ukutholakala kokudla ngokuthuthukisa ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo zakhe.
Lena yinkinga ebaluleke kakhulu kubalimi baseTanzania, njengoba izwe selihlupheka ngokuncipha kwezinto eziqhakazayo ezibalulekile ngenxa yenguquko yobunjalozwe.

Kodwa-ke, abacwaningi bathi kunzima ukulinganisa impumelelo yokungenelela okuhlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu, njengokwenza umquba, futhi abalimi ngokwabo ababuzwa njalo ukuthi ngabe ukungenelela kusebenza ngendlela ebhaliwe.

Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuklama indlela yokulinganisa impumelelo yokungenelela okuhlakaniphile kwesimo sezulu, ngokugxila ngokukhethekile ekuthuthukiseni ukutholakala kokudla nokuvumelana nezimo.
Ekuqaleni, bafunda ezinye izifundo zezolimo, baphumelela ngezixhumanisi ezimbili ezaziqukethe izici eziyi-14, noma “izinkomba”, ezibalulekile ekuqondeni ukutholakala kokudla nokuzivumelanisa nezimo.
Bese, bebenza eSifundazweni saseLushoto eTanzania, abacwaningi basebenzisana nabalimi bendawo kanye nochwepheshe abaningi bezemilimi ukuze bakhombe izinkomba ezibaluleke kakhulu kuwo wonke amahlu.
Abalimi baqaphele ukuthi ukukhiqizwa kokudla kubaluleke kakhulu ekuqinisekiseni ukutholakala kokudla.
Ngamanye amazwi, noma yikuphi ukungenelela okwakuthuthukisa isivuno sezitshalo zabo kwakuqatshelwa kakhulu.

Khonamanjalo, ngokubhekisele ekuqondeni, abalimi babethakazelisa ngokukhethekile ukungenelela okubasiza ukuthi bavikele inhlabathi yezimafa zabo, kanye nalokho okuthuthukisa ulwazi, amakhono, kanye nomholo wabo.
Ngemva kokuba abacwaningi sebeqinisekisile ukubaluleka kwesibonisi ngasinye, bakwazi ukuzisebenzisa ukuhlola ukuphumelela kwezinhlobo eziyisithupha zokungenelela eLushoto.
Kulabo bonke, babuza abalimi bendawo, ngesilinganiso esingu-1-5, ukuthi ngabe kwakukhona ukwanda kwesibonakaliso ngasinye kusukela lapho ukungenelela kuqala.
Lokhu kwenze kwaba nokwenzeka ukubona ukuthi yikuphi ukungenelela okwakunethonya elikhulu ekukhuleni kokudla nasekuzivumelaniseni nezimo.
Bathole ukuthi ukungenelela okungu-3 kuphela kwengu-6 okusetshenziswayo kwakunethonya langempela.
Lezo zazizinhlobo zezitshalo ezilungele ukwenziwa umquba, ezibekezelela isomiso, futhi zinikeza ukudla okungcono kwezilwane.

Abacwaningi bathi indlela yabo yenza kube lula ukuqinisekisa ukuthi ukungenelela kwesikhathi esizayo kuhlangabezana nezidingo zabalimi baseLushoto kanye nemigomo yezolimo ezihlakaniphile ngesimo sezulu.
Bengeza ukuthi ukukhetha ukungenelela okulungile kuphinde kukhulise amathuba okuba abalimi bancoma imikhuba emihle kubamelene babo, ngaleyo ndlela basakaza imibono eyi-climate smart.

Ngamafuphi, le ndlela ingasetshenziswa nakwezinye izindawo, futhi ingasiza ekuqinisekiseni ukuthi amasu okuhlakanipha kwesimo sezulu abheka izimo zendawo nolwazi lwabalimi ngokubeka iliso okuqhubekayo nokulinganisa.

Ngokuyenza kanjalo, izinhlelo zokusebenza zezolimo ezihlakaniphile zesimo sezulu zinezithembiso eziningi zokuba yimpumelelo futhi zithole ukwamukelwa, kokubili eThanzaniya nakwamanye amazwe ase-Afrika.
Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana kososayensi base-Kenya nase-Netherlands.
Izimbangazifo zezilwane ezinomgogodla njengezinhlobo ezihlaselayo: Ukuqonda okuvela eNingizimu Afrika
Ucwaningo lwezinto eziphilayo ezibangela izifo njengohlobo lwezilwane nezitshalo zokufika aluzange lutholakale lukhulu kakhulu emkhakheni wesayensi yokufika.
Izimbangazifo ezifakiwe zingaba nemiphumela emikhulu ezintweni eziphilayo, ezemvelo ezihlala kuzo, kanye nomnotho osekelwa yilezo zemvelo.

Kulesi sahluko, sisebenzisa izifundo zezigameko zezifo ezifakiwe zezilwane zasekhaya nezasendle (amarabi ezimpungwini, isisu eliyisifo kubusika, ne-rinderpest) nabantu (ubulwelwe, isifo sokuqhaqhazela ne-HIV) ukuchaza izinhlobo zemiphumela lezi zimbangazifo ezingaba nazo.

Uthonyo olukhulu kunazo zonke oluye lwabonakala kuze kube manje luye lwaba lukwesi sifo serinderpest, esibangele ukufa kwezinkomo eziningi, futhi sibhubhise cishe izinhlobo ezithile zezilwane zasendle ezingxenyeni ezinkulu zeNingizimu Afrika.
Lokhu ngokwalo kuye kwathinta kakhulu umnotho wesifunda, futhi kwabangela izinguquko ezinkulu esakhiweni nasemikhakheni yezemvelo.

Isifo se-rinderpest sisusiwe emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa isifo samarabi sezinja kanye ne-tuberculosis yezilwane ezifuywayo zisaphila, futhi kuzodingeka ukulinda nokulawula okuqhubekayo ukuze kuvinjelwe.
Ezifweni zabantu, isifo se-smallpox naso siphelile emhlabeni jikelele, kodwa umphumela walesi sifo, esalethwa abakoloni baseYurophu, wawubhubhisayo.

Ekuqaleni kwawo-1700, izingxenye ezinkulu (zingafika ku-90% kwamanye amabandla) zabantu bakwaKhoekhoe abangabantu bomdabu bafa, kwabhubha amasiko abo nendlela yabo yokuphila, kwashiya abasindile abambalwa ukuthi baqashwe njengabasebenzi befama.

I-HIV, eyatholakala okokuqala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982, iye yaba nemiphumela emikhulu futhi ukwelashwa ngemithi yokulwa ne-HIV kuphela kusetshenziswa imali engu-R66.4 billion minyaka yonke uhulumeni.
Sihlanganisa ne-West Nile Virus ne-African Swine Fever njengezibonelo zezifo eziqale e-Afrika, futhi okungenzeka zibe yizinhlekelele emhlabeni jikelele.
Siqikelela ukuthi izifo ezintsha ziyophumela njengoba abantu beqhubeka bandise indawo yabo ezindaweni zasendle, futhi njengoba amazinga okuhweba ekhuphuka.
Okwaziwa ngososayensi ngezinto eziphilayo ezincane ezingabonakali ngamehlo ezibangela izifo eNingizimu Afrika

Lesi sahluko sencwadi sihlanganisa ulwazi lwakamuva mayelana nezifo ezinjenge-rinderpest, i-rabies, i-measles ne-i-hiv (isandulela ngculaza), zonke ezihambisana nezinto eziphilayo ezincane ezihlaselayo (ama-virus, ama-bacteria nezinye izidalwa ezincane ezibhekwa njengezinhlobo ezingaziwa, kusho ukuthi azitholakali ngokwemvelo endaweni ethile).
Lezi zifo zonke zithinta izilwane nabantu eNingizimu Afrika, futhi ukuqubuka kokukhulu kwenza umonakalo ekuphileni komnotho wezwe.

Enkundleni yocwaningo ebizwa ngokuthi ‘isayensi ehlaselayo’, ososayensi bafunda izinto eziphilayo ezikhula kahle futhi zenze umonakalo ngemva kokuthi zifakwe ezindaweni ezintsha lapho zingatholakali khona ngokujwayelekile.
Ucwaningo oluningi luye lwogxila ezilwaneni ezinkulu “ezihlaselayo” njengezitshalo nezilwane, kodwa izilwane ezincane kakhulu ezingabangela izifo ziyabaluleka ngokufanayo.
Kulesi sahluko, ababhali baxoxe ngezinye izifo zezilwane nabantu eNingizimu Afrika ezihambisana nezinhlanzi ezingaphandle.
Bathe ukuthi isifo esibi kakhulu kwakuwukugula kwezilwane, okwatholakala eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1896.
Isifo se-Rinderpest sasiyisifo esibangelwa yi-virus futhi sasihlasela izinkomo nezinyathi.
Igciwane elifanayo liholele e-measles kubantu.
Abantu abaningi basemakhaya bahlushwa yindlala ngemva kokuphahlazeka kuka-1896, kodwa manje lesi sifo sisusiwe ngokugomela.
Ababhali bathi phakathi kuka-1772 no-1861, izinja eziningi eNingizimu Afrika zazinamarabi, ngisho noma abantu babengalwazi ukuthi yisiphi lesi sifo.
Ngo-1893, kwakwaziwa ukuthi amarabi abangelwa yi-virus, ngakho uhulumeni wanquma ukubulala izinja ezikhuthazwe futhi agomele ezingathintwanga.
Kodwa-ke, lokhu akuzange kuqede lesi sifo futhi sasithinta izilwane eziningi zasendle njenge-duikers, izimpisi, izinja zasendle, izimpungushe nezimpungushe.
Ababhali bathi ngo-1928, abantwana ababili bakhonjwa yi-mongoose ephuzi bafa ngamarabi.
Kusukela ngaleso sikhathi, amarabi abe avamile eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathe bakhuluma ngo-1954, abaseNingizimu Afrika abaningi nabo bathinteka yi-measles.
Lapho le sahluko sibhalwa, isifo sikamabulelo sasibulala izingane ezingaba ngu-400 nsuku zonke.
Bathi isifo sikamabulelo sasivame lapho abantu nezinyamazane behlala eduze.
Ababhali baphinda bakhuluma ngesifo esibizwa ngokuthi isifo sofuba sezinkomo (BTB), esibangelwa amagciwane.
IBTB yabulala izinkomo, izinyathi, izinqindi, izingwe, amabhubesi, amakudu, izinongo kanye nezingonyama.
Bathe isifo se-BTB sabikwa okokuqala ephaki likazwelonke laseNingizimu Afrika ngo-1996.
Uhulumeni walawula lesi sifo ngokubulala izinyathi ezikhungethwe.
Ababhali bathi olunye ugciwane, oluthunyelwe eNingizimu Afrika ngabahambi abavela eYurophu, lwalubangela isifo esibizwa ngokuthi “isihlangu” kubantu.
Lesi sifo sibulale abantu abangaphezu kuka-90% abantu bakithi baseKhoekhoe.
Ekupheleni kokubhebhetheka kwalesi sifo, amasiko amaKhoekhoe ayebhubile cishe ngokuphelele.
Ababhali babike futhi nge-HIV (isandulela ngculaza) esabangela ukubhebhetheka kwesifo se-AIDS.
Osayensi basacabanga ukuthi igciwane laqala ukudluliselwa kubantu lisuka ezilwaneni, ngenqubo ebizwa ngokuthi i-zoonosis.
Igciwane laqale lafumanwa eNingizimu Afrika ngo-1982.
Bathe, ngo-2019, i-HIV yayingenamgomo noma ukwelapha.
Baphetha isahluko ngokukhuluma nge-West Nile Virus ne-African Swine Fever, abathi zaqala e-Afrika zasabekela eYurophu naseMelika.
I-West Nile virus yasabalala ngomiyane yabulala ikakhulu izinyoni, kodwa futhi yathinta namakhona nabantu.
Bathe izilwane ezinjengezingulube zasendle nezinyathi zasendle zidlulisele isifo se-African swine fever.
Lesi sifo sithinte izinkukhu, futhi sithinte kakhulu ibhizinisi lezingulube.
Ababhali bathi bakhulume ngezifo ezibangelwa yibhaktheriya namavirus kuphela, ngakho-ke le sahluko asiyona ingxelo ephelele yama-microorganism onke ahlaselayo.
Ababhali bebeqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika.
Uhlelo lokusebenza lokuhlinzwa olusekwe ebufakazini lokulawula i-Odontogenic keratocyst
Ukuphathwa okuphumelelayo kwe-odontogenic keratocyst (OKC) kuhlala kuyisihloko esithakazelisayo nesiphazamisayo ezincwadini zokuhlinzwa komlomo nemaxillofacial.
Okwamanje, ayikho imibono efanayo mayelana nokwelapha okuhle kakhulu kwabaguli abane-odontogenic keratocyst.
Ezinye zezindlela zokwelapha ezitholakalayo, azikho izindlela kuze kube manje ezibonise amazinga okuphindaphinda angama-zero noma aseduze ne-zero ngaphandle kokusika okubanzi ngemikhawulo ecacile.

Ngenxa yokuntuleka kwemibhalo ebonisa izindlela zokwelapha eziqondene nobufakazi zokwelapha iziguli ezine-odontogenic keratocyst, lo cwaningo luhlosile ukwethula uhlelo lokusebenza lokuhlinzwa, olusekelwe emiphumeleni yokuhlaziya okuningi, oluzozuzisa ekuthuthukiseni ukwelashwa kwabaguli abanesimo.

Sisebenzisa imingcele yokulinganisa; usayizi, uhlobo lwesilonda (esokuqala noma esesibili), ukubonakala kwesilonda (esingapheli noma esisodwa), ukuba khona kweziqu eziqhekekile, kanye nokuhlukaniswa; sibeka umuthi wokunquma, ukusiza ekuhleleni ukwelashwa nokusiza ukuthola amathuba amancane okuphinda kuvela ekuphatheni i-odontogenic keratocyst.
Abacwaningi baphakamisa izindlela zokwelapha kangcono isifo somlomo.
Ngokuhlanganisa imiphumela yizifundo ezikhona, abacwaningi baqamba izinyathelo ezicacile abangazilandela odokotela ukuze bahlonze futhi baphathe iziguli ezine-odontogenic keratocyst (OKC).
I-OKC iyilonda, noma ukukhula okungavamile, emaxatheni omuntu.
Odokotela bathola ukuthi lesi simo kunzima ukusilekelela, futhi iziguli zivame ukuthola enye i-OKC ngisho nangemva kokwelashwa okuphumelelayo.
Ngakho-ke, odokotela bafuna izindlela zokwelapha ngempumelelo nangokuphelele lezi zilonda emagagwini.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bafune izinyathelo ezibalulekile odokotela okufanele bazithathe ukuze bahlonze futhi baphathe lesi sifo.
Bakwenza lokhu ngokucinga emibhalweni ekhona, noma ezinhloko zezinto zesayensi, mayelana ne-OKC.
Babefuna ngokuqondile ulwazi mayelana nendlela odokotela abaphatha ngayo i-OKC phakathi nonyaka, njengoba kubikwe ezihlokweni ezingu-46 abazitholile.

Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi i-OKC yayivame kakhulu kubantu besilisa kunabesifazane, futhi ingathinta abantu abaneminyaka efinyelela kwengu-90, ngisho noma yayivame phakathi kweminyaka engama-20 nengam-30.
Lesi sifo sithinte kakhulu umgubazana.
I-OKC iqala ngaphakathi kwempumputhe, ukukhula komlomo kubonakala kamuva kuphela.
Iziguli zazivame ukuzwa ubuhlungu futhi zazinawo amanye amachasha (izintokozo, njengophuphu, oluphuma esilondeni noma ekulimala), futhi imizuzu yamazinyo azo ingase ihambe endaweni.
Baphakamisa ukuthi odokotela basuse yonke inxeba nezinye izinyo ezikude.

Uma sekuqediwe, kufanele basebenzise imithi ebizwa ngeCarnoy’s solution, kanye ne-liquid nitrogen (ilwetshe elipholile kakhulu elisetshenziswa ukususa isikhumba esonakele ngokushesha) ne-fluorouracil (eyaziwa nangokuthi yi-5FU, imithi evamile yomdlavuza).
Ngemva kwalokhu kulashwa, abacwaningi baye bancoma ukuthi isiguli kufanele sibe nokuhlolwa kwezempilo okulandelayo iminyaka engaba ngu-25.
Bathe leli lungiselelo lilungile kakhulu ezilondeni ezincane kunesithelo se-strawberry (3 cm).
Kubasilonda ezinkulu kuna-3 cm, abacwaningi baye baphakamisa ukunakekelwa okwengeziwe.
Bathe odokotela kufanele baqale banciphise ingcindezi ngaphakathi kwesilonda bese basusa uketshezi, futhi basuse wonke amafutha asezungeze umgubhu.
Kumelwe-ke ukuthi ithambo liphelelwe ngesisombululo seCarnoy.
Baphakamise ukuthi odokotela kufanele bahlole leziguli njalo ngenyanga ezimbili iminyaka emibili.
Uma isiguli sinizilonda eziningi, odokotela bangazikhupha ngezinye izinto zezibhedlela ezikhethekile.
Kodwa ngokuyinhloko, izifundo ezabuyekezwa zikhombise ukuthi ezigamekweni eziningi, uma odokotela besusa isifo bese befake i-5FU, iziguli azizukubuye zithole i-OKC.
Nokho, baxwayise ngokuthi ubufakazi bemishanguzo leyo abubunamandla ngaso sonke isikhathi, futhi bathola izincwadi zesayensi ezimbalwa ngale ndaba.

Abacwaningi abazange futhi benze ama-experimenthi abo ukuze banikeze izincomo; kunalokho, bazama ukuqoqa izinketho zokwelapha ezihamba phambili ezaziwa ezivela eziphindweni ezenziwe abanye abacwaningi.
Ngakho-ke, laba bacwaningi, abaseNigeria nase-USA, baphakamise ukuthi kwenziwe izifundo eziningi emazweni ahlukahlukene ukuze kuphenjwe impumelelo yemithi ephakanyiswe lapha.
Baphinde bakhuthaza odokotela ukuba bacabangele ezinye izimo zeziguli ngesikhathi sokwelapha.
I-SARS-CoV-2 (2019-nCoV), i-MERS-CoV ne-SARSr-CoV eyenziwe ngokwenziwa: Ukuhlaziywa okuningiliziwe kokulinganisa ukusikisela ama-epitope angaba khona

Ama-khuvethe avame ukuba ngawomgomo oluthile lwabantu, izilwane ezincelisayo noma izinyoni kuye ngohlobo lwazo; kodwa-ke, la ma-khuvethe ngezinye izikhathi angashintsha umsingathi ngenxa yokuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo.

I-HCoV-229E ingenye yezinhlobo eziyisithupha zokhuvethe lwabantu ezihlanganisa i-HCoV-NL63, i-HCoV-OC43, i-HCoV-HKU1, i-MERS-CoV ne-SARSr-CoV (i-SARSr-CoV-1 ne-SARS-CoV2) futhi isabalalele emhlabeni jikelele.
I-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV-2 zingaphila ezintweni ezingaphili njenge (ensimbi, igalasi noma ipulasitiki kuze kube izinsuku ezingu-9) (Huang, C.-L, 2020).
Izinyathelo zokuvikela kanye nokuphathwa kwesifo nge-hydroxychloroquine kuyasiza, kodwa umgomo omuhle osebenza kahle ungase ube yilona olukhulu ekumisweni kokusabalala kwemphathamhlaba i-covid-19.
Inhloso yocwaningo lwethu kwakuwukuthola ama-epitope angaba ngumgomo ngezindlela ze-bioinformatics.
Izinto nezindlela

Imininingwane ephelele yofuzo lwe-SARS-CoV-2 ithathwe ku-2019 Novel Coronavirus Resource (2019nCoVR) nasezindaweni ezimbili zolwazi, okuhlanganisa i-National Center for Biotechnology Information (NCBI) Global Initiative on Sharing All Influenza Data (GISAID) ne-TAURAU/T-bio-infoserver ye-bioinformatics eku-inthanethi.

Sizokunikeza isifinyezo esifushane sokuvela kwe-viral, siqhathanise idatha yokuqapha ukuze kutholwe indawo ehlala iphelele, i-domain yayo ye-protein evame kakhulu (indawo yokubopha okuqondiwe) kanye nokwakhiwa kwe-motif okuvumelana nayo ngomkhiqizo onamandla (epitope) wokuncoma izindlela zokwelapha zesifo esisha esitholwe i-2019-nCoV, i-SARSr-CoV strain ne-MERS-CoV.

Ngokuthakazelisayo, ukuqhathaniswa kolandelana phakathi kwe-SARS-CoV-2 nezinye izinhlobo kwembule ukuthi izinsalela ezikhona ekuqalisweni kokusebenzisana ne-receptor zigcinwe kakhulu ngokufana okungu-70%.
Sihlinzeke ngezimali izakhamzimba ezibalulekile ezinhlanu (L455, Y473, N479, F486, Q493) esizindeni sokubopha i-receptor evela kumaphrotheni e-spike abhekene nokuthintana phakathi kwe-virus ne-horst.
Ku-SARS-CoV-2 RBD kukhona izinsalela (D480, ne-T487) ezivumele ukutheleleka phakathi kwezinhlobo.
Kodwa-ke, ku-SARS-CoV-2, ukuguqulwa okuncane kwezinye izinto ezihlanganisayo kungathuthukisa ukusebenzisana nomukelwa we-cellular wabantu: L455, F486, Q493, ne-N501.
Ku-SARS-CoV, izinsalela ezimbili eziyinhloko (479 no-487) ziye zahlanganiswa nokuqashelwa komamukheli we-ACE2 wabantu.
Ku-SARS-CoV-2, izinsalela ezifanele ku-N479 zihambelana ne-Q493 ne-T487 kuya ku-N501.

Sikhombe ukulandelana kwezakhamzimba ezigcinwe kahle kuwo wonke ama-coronavirus, kuhlanganise ne-2019nCoV nezinye izinhlobo, i-motif KRSFIEDLLFNKVTLADAGF itholakale ikhona kahle kulolu cwaningo futhi ihambisana nendawo ezungezile kwenye yezindawo ezaziwayo zokusika ze-SARS virus okukholelwa ukuthi kuyadingeka ukuvuselela i-virus ukuze ingene eselini.

Le motif yofuzo kanye nezinguquko ezizungezile zakha isisekelo sokusikisela i-epitope ethile yomuthi wokugomela oyenziwe ngokwenziwe; lo mtholampilo ungenza abafundi abanamanye ama-molecule amancane aqinile kanye nezinhloso zokubopha.
Ucwaningo lolu lunikeza ulwazi nethuba lokuqinisekiswa kwezinto eziphilayo.
Lo msebenzi ungachazwa ngamagama e-bioinformatics, futhi uphindwe kalula abanye, yize ulwazi olusha nocwaningo lwe-Covid-19 luvela futhi luqhubeka ngesivinini esikhulu.
Ososayensi baqhathanisa i-Covid-19 nezinhlobo zezifo ezifana nayo ukuze basize ekufuneni imigomo.
Ngo-Septhemba 2020, osayensi baseMali baqhathanisa ulwazi lofuzo oluvela egciwane le-Covid-19 namakhuvethe amabili ahlobene eduze ukuze baqonde izici ezingasiza ekuthuthukiseni umgomo.
Ngaleso sikhathi, ososayensi babesafuna imigomo ephumelelayo ye-COVID-19.
Babefuna ukuqonda ukuguquka kwezakhi zofuzo kwe-Covid-19 okungase kube nomthelela ekuthelelekeni.
Ngakho-ke, abacwaningi baseMali baqhathanise igciwane le-Covid-19 (SARS-CoV-2) namanye ama-coronavirus amabili abangela izifo kubantu, okuyi-MERS-CoV ne-SARS-CoV.
Enye yezinjongo eziyinhloko zalesi sifundo kwakuwukuthola izindawo ezithile ku-Covid-19, ebizwa ngama-epitope, ezibonwa yisistimu yokulwa nezifo yomuntu.
Ukubabonisa kungabasiza ososayensi ukuba benze imigomo ephumelelayo.
Abacwaningi baphinde baqhathanisa zonke izigciwane ezintathu ukuze babone ukuthi ngabe kukhona ubuqabane obubonakala ngofuzo obungasiza ekuthuthukiseni umgomo.
Bagxile kulandelelwano lofuzo lwamaprotheni ezinzipho zegciwane, okuyiprotheni ehambisana nokusiza ukhuvethe ukubopha, nokutheleleka, amaseli omzimba womuntu.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi amaprotheni e-spike ezigciwane zonke ezintathu ayefana kakhulu ngofuzo, ikakhulu izindawo ezihlangana namakhemikhali emzimbeni womuntu.
Okwakhamba phambili ngegciwane le-Covid-19 kwakuwukuthi kwakukhona izinguquko ezincane eprotheni ye-spike ezingenza igciwane libe nekhono lokubopha namasosha omzimba wabantu.
Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ingase ivumele abanye abacwaningi ukuthi benze imigomo ye-Covid-19 ephumelelayo ngokubasiza ukuthi baqonde izindawo emagciwane ezifanele ukuba okuqondiwe kwemigomo.
Ucwaningo luphinde lwaletha ulwazi olusha mayelana nokuthandana nokungafani kwezinto zofuzo phakathi kwe-ukhuvethe lukaCovid-19 nezinye izinhlobo ze-ukhuvethe.

Abacwaningi baphawula ukuthi ucwaningo lwesikhathi esizayo kufanele lugxile ekutheni uma kukhona umehluko wezakhi zofuzo ku-khuvethe le-Covid-19 okwenza kube nomthelela omkhulu futhi kube yingozi kunezinye izinhlobo ze-ukhuvethe.
I-Arrhythmia Yenhliziyo Kubantu AbabeNe-COVID-19: Ukubuyekezwa Okuhlelekile Nokuhlaziywa Kwemeta
Akumele kuphazanyiswe i-arrhythmia yenhliziyo kubantu abane-COVID-19 njengoba ithonya kakhulu imiphumela.
Ngakho-ke, lolu cwaningo lwaluhilele ukwakha ubufakazi obuqinile mayelana nesigameko se-arrhythmia yenhliziyo kubantu abane-COVID-19.
Senze ukucinga okuhlelekile kwizisetshenziswa zokucinga ezinokwethenjwa/izisetshenziswa zokusesha ezifaka phakathi i-PubMed, i-Scopus, i-Cochrane library ne-web of science.
Ngemva kokuhlolwa, ulwazi olufanele luye lwakhethwa, futhi izingameko ezivela eziphindweni ezihlanganisiwe zahlanganiswa ukuze kuhlanganiswe ulwazi.
Kwakufakwe ucwaningo oluyisishiyagalolunye ekugcineni kulokhu kuphenya kwethu, oluqukethe iziguli eziyi-1445.
Imiphumela yokuhlaziya okuhlanganisiwe iveze ukuthi isigameko se-arrhythmia kubantu abane-COVID-19 kwakuyi-19.7% ngesikhathi sokuqiniseka (CI) esingu-95% esiqala ku-11.7 kuya ku-27.6%.
Kwakuphinde kube khona isimo sokuhluka kokuqukethwe esibalulekile (I2□=□94.67%).
I-arrhythmia yenhliziyo yayivame kakhulu kubantu abane-COVID-19 futhi yabonwa ku-19.7% kubo.
Ukuqapha okufanele nge-electrocardiogram nokuhlonza okulungile nokusenesikhathi kwe-arrhythmias kubalulekile ekuphatheni nasemiphumeleni engcono.
Iziguli eziningi ze-COVID-19 zazine-irregular heartbeats.
Abacwaningi bathi cishe omunye kubantu abayi-5 abane-Covid-19 uhlushwa yi-arrhythmia yenhliziyo, eyaziwa nangokuthi ukushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile.

Ngenxa yokuthi kuyinto evamile, bayekethisa ukulandelela izindlela zokushaya kwenhliziyo yesiguli besebenzisa umshini obizwa ngokuthi yi-electrocardiogram, ukuze odokotela bakwazi ukuthola nokwelapha noma iyiphi i-arrhythmia kusenesikhathi.
Nakuba i-Covid-19 ilimaza amaphaphu nesimiso sokuphefumula kakhulu, ucwaningo oluthile lubonise ukuthi ingalimaza nenhliziyo.
Abacwaningi babefuna ukuhlola ulwazi lweziguli ukuze babone ukuthi izinkinga zokushona kwenhliziyo zazivame kangakanani ngempela kubantu abane-COVID-19 ngo-2020, ekuqaleni kwale impathamhlaba.

Basebenzise indlela yokuhlaziya ulwazi oluhlanganisa ukuhlaziya ucwaningo oluningi oluhlukene ngesihloko esithile, ukuze bafinyelele eziphethweni ezijwayelekile ezivela kuwo wonke ucwaningo oluhlanganisiwe.
Bafuna izifundo ezibuyekezwe ngabanye abacwaningi kuma-database avamile, baphuma noma yiluphi ulwazi olufanelekele mayelana nokushaya kwenhliziyo okungajwayelekile kubantu abane-Covid-19.
Ekugcineni, bafaka ucwaningo oluyi-9 olunemininingwane mayelana neziguli ezingu-1445.
Bathole ukuthi i-arrhythmia yenhliziyo ibonwe ku-19.7% yeziguli ezine-COVID-19.
Nokho, bayaxwayisa ngokuthi inani elincane lezincwadi abazisebenzisile lingase liqedele isiphetho sabo.
Ezinye zezifundo azizange zichaze ngokuqondile uhlobo oluthile lwezinkinga zenhliziyo, futhi imikhawulo yaleli cwaningo ngalinye ingase ihlanganise imikhawulo yokuhlaziya kwazo konke ulwazi.
Baphakamisa ukuthi kuqwalaselwe esikhathini esizayo ukuthi kungani iziguli eziningi ezine-Covid-19 zazinezinkinga zenhliziyo.
Ababhali baleli phepha bebeqhamuka eGibhithe, kodwa iziguli zalesi cwaningo bezivela eChina nase-USA.
Iimbono Zesayensi Ezinye Ngokufuduka, Impilo Yengqondo ne-PTSD:
Ukuhlaziywa kwezincwadi ezifanele
Kulesi sahluko, sinikezela ngokubuyekezwa kwezincwaningo ezibhekiwe ezenziwe kwi-PTSD, impilo yengqondo kanye nempilo enhle yabafuduki.
Ucwaningo oluningi lubonisa ukuthi kokubili ukucindezeleka kokufuduka kwangaphambi nangemva kokufuduka kuchaphazela impilo yengqondo ne-PTSD yabafuduki nababaleki.
Emazweni okuqala, ukubhekana nokulimala nokuxhashazwa kwakubeka ingozi enkulu empilweni yengqondo yabafuduki.

Izinkinga zempilo yengqondo ezibangela ukucindezeleka okukhulu kubafuduki emazweni abawamukele zihlanganisa ukucindezeleka kwengqondo, isimo/izinga somthetho, ukuhlukaniswa komndeni, isikhombikubona sokuqonda ulimi, ukufinyelela okungekuhle ekunakekelweni kwempilo okufanele, ukucwaswa, ubuhlanga, imizwa yokungabi namandla, ukwehla kokuzithemba, ukucindezeleka kwamahlalakhona nokuqapha okukhulu.
Kuzo zonke izinkinga zempilo yengqondo, ukhwantalala, ukukhathazeka ne-PTSD kubhekwa njengokujwayelekile kakhulu ngezibalo zokusabalala ezingama-4–40%, 5–44% ne-9–36% ngokulandelana.
Ngokuvamile, ukwesekwa komphakathi nezindlela zokubhekana nezimo ezihambisana nesimo kwabonakala njengokunciphisa ukuthinteka.
Impilo yengqondo yombaleki ithinteka yisimo esishiywe ngemuva nokuxazulula indawo entsha.
Abafuduki nababaleki ababalekela emazweni angaphandle bavame ukuhlupheka ubuhlungu obungapheli bokucindezeleka okungemva kokulimalwa nezinye izinkinga zempilo yengqondo.
Nakuba izinkinga eziningi zibangelwa izinto ezenzeka emazweni abo asekhaya, ososayensi bathi kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ukucindezeleka kokuphila ezweni elisha kungakwengeza kule nkinga.
Ngokwophenyo oluhlukahlukene, ukhwantalala, ukukhathazeka, ne-PTSD konke kuyizinkinga ezivamile zempilo yengqondo kubafuduki nababaleki.
I-PTSD ngokuvamile iyimbangela yokusinda kwezehlakalo eziyingozi noma ezilimazayo, futhi abantu bavame ukuhlangabezana nemiphumela yalezo zenzakalo ezimbi izinyanga, noma ngisho neminyaka.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukuqonda izici ezahlukene ezidlalayo indima ezinkingeni zempilo yengqondo yabafuduki njenge-PTSD.
Ngakho-ke, benze uhlobo locwaningo olubizwa ngokuthi isibuyekezo, lapho bafingqa khona ulwazi oluvela kwezinye izifundo eziningi ngesihloko, ukuze bathole izindlela ezivamile noma izingqikithi.
Ezimweni eziningi, izinkinga zempilo yengqondo zabafuduki zazibangelwa yizenzakalo ezibuhlungu ezinjengempi, ukulahlekelwa abathandekayo, noma ubudlova bomzimba obuqale emazweni abo.
Lapho laba bantu bephuma kulezo zimo, bahlangabezana nohambo oluyiminkantsha kodwa kamuva bazwa ukuthula lapho befika ezweni elisha.
Abacwaningi bathi, noma kunjalo, ukuthula lokhu kwakuyikwesikhashana, ngoba abafuduki bahlangabezana nezinselelo ezintsha ngemva kokufuduka.
Bathole ukuthi abafuduki bavame ukuba nezikhathi ezinzima ezweni elisha, ikakhulu uma bengayiqondi ulimi, noma behluleka ukujwayela amasiko.

Uma abantu befike ezweni ngokungemthetho, noma babezama ukuthola indawo yokukhosela, kwakudingeka baphathane nezingqinamba zomthetho, futhi bavame ukuba nobunzima bokuthola izinsizakalo ezinjengalezo zezempilo.
Kwabanye, ubandlululo nokuhlukunyezwa ngokohlanga ezweni labo elisha kwanezela emizwelweni yabo yokungaphephile, futhi abaningi bashiye amalungu omndeni babo ngemuva futhi babe bodwa.
Lezi zici zinezandla ekubeni khona kwezinkinga zempilo yengqondo eziqhubekayo, ngisho nalapho laba bafuduki besesimweni esiphephile kunesikhathi sasemzini wabo.

Abacwaningi benezela ukuthi abafuduki babe nezindlela eziningi ezahlukene zokubhekana nalezi zinkinga, kusukela ekucwaningeni ngokucophelela ukuthi bangazixazulula kanjani, kuya ekufuneni usizo kwabanye emphakathini wabo, noma izindlela ezimbi kakhulu njengokusebenzisa izidakamizwa.
Abacwaningi bathi ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka kuzo zonke izigaba zohambo lomfuduki.
Ngokuqondile, kubalulekile ukucwaninga izici eziqeda impilo yengqondo emazweni abantu abahlala kuwo, kodwa futhi isikhathi eside emazweni abo amasha.
Bengeza ukuthi uhambo lwabantu abasuka e-Afrika beya eYurophu ludinga ukunakekelwa okuningiliziwe yibo abacwaningi.
Lolu cwaningo bekuwukubambisana phakathi kososayensi abaseNingizimu Afrika naseJalimane, futhi luyingxenye yencwadi ephathelene namava abafuduki base-Afrika abahlala emazweni aseYurophu.
Ukuba khona nokuqhubeka kukhona kuka-Amblyomma hebraeum kukhuphula umthwalo we-Heartwater esifundeni sangaseningizimu seBotswana.
I-Heartwater yisifo esithwalwa amakhizane, esiyisifo sokuphazamiseka kwegazi, esinokukwazi ukulinganiselwa ukukhula kwamabhizinisi ezilimo eBotswana.
Lesiyingozi ekuphepheni kokudla kwesizwe kubangelwa ukuncishiswa kokukhiqizwa nokufa kwemfuyo ekuhlinzekeni kokudla okuncane kunasemapulazini ezohwebo.
Lolu cwaningo lubonisa ubunzima be-epidemiological ye-heartwater eBotswana.
Amakhizane adliwe yizilwane ezifuywayo ezingaphansi kwezifunda ezine zaseNingizimu Afrika atholakele ngokusebenzisa ukuhlaziywa komzimba kanye nokusebenzisa i-molecular.
Abalimi baqoshulwa ngokuphathwa komthwalo we-heartwater ezigabeni zabo.
Amacala ezempilo yezilwane aqoqwe ukuhlola ukuvamile kwamacala kulo lonke isifunda saseNingizimu eBotswana.

Imiphumela yophenyo iveze; ukwanda okukhulu kwe-Amblyomma hebraeum kuzo zonke izindawo ezine ezifundwe, ukwanda kancane kweminyaka yecala le-heartwater eMoshupa kanye nokubonakala kokwanda komthelela ezinhlotsheni zasekhaya zezimbuzi naphezu kokuzimisela kokulawula izilwane ezincane ezilumanayo ngama-63% abalimi abaqashwe.

I-Amblyomma hebraeum, isilwane esincane esilumanayo esiyinhloko se-Ehrlichia ruminantium eNingizimu Afrika, isabalalele kakhulu eSigabeni Eseningizimu saseBotswana futhi ngaleyondlela ibeka inselele ekukhiqizweni kwemfuyo kulesi sigaba, futhi mhlawumbe, nakwezinye izingxenye zezwe lapho leli khizane lihlasela khona imfuyo.
Ngakho-ke, kunesidingo sokubuyekezwa kabusha kwezindlela zokulawula amakhizane ezisekhona ngenhloso yokunciphisa umthwalo wesifo se-heartwater ikakhulukazi ezikweni nasezimbuzini.
Inani elikhulu lamakhizane eNingizimu Botswana liyenza isimo sibe sibi kakhulu sesifo se-heartwater ezilwaneni.
Ucwaningo olu luveza umthwalo omkhulu wamakhizane nesifo se-heartwater eNingizimu Botswana phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ingasiza uhulumeni nabalimi ukuthi benze amacebo okulawula kangcono isifo se-heartwater.
Amakhizane athile aphethe ibhaktheriya ebizwa nge-Ehrlichia ruminantium, ebangela isifo esaziwa ngokuthi yi-heartwater ezinkomeni, ezimvini nasezimbuzi.
Leli gciwane liyisiphukuphuku, kusho ukuthi liyadla ezinye izinto eziphilayo ezifana nemfuyo, lilibangele ukulimala.
Izilwane ezikhulayo ezine-heartwater, ngokuvamile zibe nokuqina komzimba okuphezulu, zilahlekelwe yisifiso sokudla, zibe nezinkinga zokuphefumula, futhi zingase zife ekugcineni.
Isifo se-Heartwater sivame kakhulu ingxenye eseningizimu yeBotswana, futhi abalimi kuleyo ndawo bayalahlekelwa yimfuyo yabo ngenxa yalesi sifo.
Kulesi sifundo, abacwaningi bahlole ubunzima besifo se-heartwater eNingizimu Botswana.
Baqale bathatha, babale, baze bahlonze amaqabunga ezinkomeni, eemvini nasezimbuzini ukuze baqhathanise inani lamaqabunga aphethe i-parasite ye-heartwater namanye amaqabunga.
Abacwaningi baphinda baxoxa nabanye abalimi ngamava abo nge-heartwater, baqoqa neminye imibiko ye-heartwater ehhovisi lezilwane (lempilo yezilwane).
Abacwaningi bathi amakhizane abangela ubuhlungu ayebandakanyeka kakhulu endaweni yocwaningo, nokuthi inani lezehlakalo zesifo se-heartwater likhuphuke unyaka nonyaka.
Baqoqe izikhuhlane ezingu-310 phakathi kuka-2017 no-2019.
Bathole izinhlobo ezintathu zamakhizane: ikhizane elibomvu laseNingizimu Afrika, ikhizane elinezinyawo ezibomvu, kanye nekhizane eliqondile lezinja.
Eyona ivamile kwakuwukhizane lomhlaba waseNingizimu Afrika (85%), futhi lona elithwala ibhaktheriya ebangela isifo senhliziyo.

Ezinye izinhlobo ezimbili zamakhizane abazibonile azinikezi ngalutho ekusabalaleni kwesifo senhliziyo, kodwa zihlanganiswe nezinye izifo zezinkomo ezifana ‘ne-theileriosis’, ‘i-anaplasmosis’ ne ‘babesiosis’.
Indawo abacwaningi ababeyifunda ihlanganisa iGoodhope, iKanye, iMoshupa, neJwaneng.
Amakhizane ayenanda kakhulu eGoodhope, eKanye naseMoshupa.
Lezi zindawo zaziningi zinothile, zinamatshe futhi zinezitshalo eziningi.
IJwaneng, elalinenani elincane kakhulu lamakhizane, lalomile, liyisanti futhi lalinotshani oluncane.

Abacwaningi bathi amarekhodi ezempilo yezilwane aveze ukuthi kunezimo ezingama-42 ze-heartwater eGoodhope, ezingama-38 eJwaneng, ezingama-75 eKanye, nezingama-146 eMoshupa, kusukela ngo-2017 kuya ku-2019.
Abacwaningi bathi i-heartwater ibetha izimbuzi nezinkomo zasekhaya kakhulu kunazo ezivela kwamanye amazwe.
Bathe abalimi benze imizamo ethile yokulawula amakhizane.
Isibonelo, ama-63% abalimi babethambisa izilwane ngezibulala-zinambuzane (amakhemikhali asetshenziswa ukubulala izinambuzane ezinjengamakhizane).
Cishe ingxenye yesithathu (30%) yabalimi yayigcoba izilwane zabo ngamafutha ukuze ilawule amakhizane, kanti abanye (7%) babezama ukwakha izingadi ezintsha.

Abacwaningi bathole futhi ukuthi abalimi abangama-44% abazange benze lutho ngesilwane esabangelwa ukuba sisiguli, kanti abangama-15% bathi babeyovakashela abasebenzi bezokwelapha izilwane ukuze bathole iseluleko, kodwa bona ngokwabo banika izilwane imithi.
Ngaphandle kokuba umgomo wokuvimbela isifo se-heartwater wawukhona, abacwaningi bathi abalimi abangama-93% abawusebenzisi.
Abalimi batjela abacwaningi ukuthi kwakungenxa yokuthi babengafundiswanga ngomgomo, futhi ngoba babengenakukwazi ukuthenga umgomo.

Ezinye izifundo esikhathini esidlule zihlole indlela amakhizane ahlukaniswe ngayo e-Afrika, kuhlanganise neBotswana, kodwa ngokusho kwabacwaningi, eyabo yiyona yokuqala ukubheka ubudlelwano phakathi kwamakhizane nezimpawu ze-heartwater eBotswana.

Bathe bakhuluma ukuthi izigameko ze-heartwater ezirekhodiwe ngamadokota ezilwane zingase zibe ngaphansi kwezigameko ezange zenzeke kubalimi, ngoba odokotela bezilwane bavame ukuhlola kuphela isifo se-heartwater lapho isilwane sifile, kusho ukuthi izilwane eziphila ngalesi sifo noma izilwane eziphulukile azibalwa njalo.
Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi abalimi kufanele bafundiswe ukuthi balawule futhi baphathe kanjani isifo se-heartwater ezilwaneni zabo, ukuze kunciphise umthwalo waso kule ndawo.
Baphinde bathi kufanele kwenziwe ucwaningo olwengeziwe ukuze kuqondwe izinto ezibangela ukwanda kwamakhizane.
Abacwaningi bebezinze eBotswana.
Izithiyo zokuhlola eceleni kombhedlela eNdiya naseNingizimu Afrika

Ukuhlolwa okutholakala endaweni (POC) emiphakathini, emakhaya, nasezikhungweni zezempilo zokuqala kukholelwa ukuthi kunamandla amakhulu ekunciphiseni ukubambezeleka ekutholeni nokuqaleni kokwelashwa kwezifo ezinjenge-HIV, igciwane le-TB, isifilis, nomalaleveva.

Ukuxilongwa okusheshayo nezinqumo zokuphatha okuqhubekayo ezenziwa ngesikhathi esifanayo sokuhlangana kwezokwelapha noma okungenani ngosuku olufanayo, ngesikhathi isiguli silinde, kuthembisa ukunqoba ukubambezeleka okuhlotshaniswa nokuhlolwa okuvamile kwelabhorethri.
Kodwa-ke, ukuba khona kwezinsizakuhlola eziphansi, ezilula, nezisheshayo ezingenziwa ngaphandle kwelabhorethri akusho ukuthi ukuhlola okuqhutshwa endaweni yokuhlala kuzokwenzeka ngempumelelo.

Ukuze siqonde izindima ezintsha nezinselelo amadivayisi ezempilo anjengalawa abhekana nazo, kudingeka sifunde ukuthi ukuhlolela isifo kusetshenziswa kanjani e-POC futhi kuhlanganiswe kanjani emsebenzini kanye nezinzila zeziguli.
Lesi sahluko sihlola imiphumela ekhethiwe evela ephrosektini yocwaningo olufanele mayelana nezithiyo zokuhlola i-POC eNdiya naseNingizimu Afrika futhi luxoxa ngazo ngokuqhathaniswayo.

Le projekthi isebenzise izingxoxo ezingahleliwe kanye namaqembu okugxilwe kuwo ukuhlola amasiko okuxilonga ezifweni ezinkulu kanye nabadlali emakhaya, emaklinikhi, emiphakathini, ezibhedlela, nakwezilabhorethri eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Uma siqhathanisa imiphumela ekhethiwe, kucace kakhulu ukuthi amazwe omabili anamasistimu ahlukene kakhulu okuxilonga asabela ngezimo ezihlukene kakhulu zokuhlola okutholakala endaweni.
Isahluko siphetha ngokuzindla ngokuthi ungazithatha kanjani lezi zibonelo ekwakheni izinhlelo zokuhlola i-POC.
Ukuhlolwa okubi kwezempilo eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya kulimaza ukunakekelwa kwezempilo.
Ukukhathalela indawo (POC) kubhekisela ekuhlolweni kwezempilo okwenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho isigulisi samukela khona ukunakekelwa, kunokuthumela izisampula zesiguli kwenye ilebhu ukuze kuhlolwe.
INingizimu Afrika neNdiya azinikezi ukuhlolwa okusheshayo nokuphumelelayo ngenxa yemisila yazo emibi ye-POC nama-labhorethri.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-POC kuvumela iziguli ukuba zithole ukuhlolwa okusheshayo ngemiphumela esheshayo yokwelashwa nokuphathwa kwezifo.
Lokhu kungenziwa ngemishini eshibhile futhi elula engabuyisela imiphumela yokuhlola ngokushesha ngaphandle kokuthatha izisampula kuyilabhorethri.
Kepha kuningi izinselelo e-POC ezithiya ukunakekelwa kwabaguli eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya.
Ababhali babefuna ukuqhathanisa ukuhlolwa kwe-POC eNingizimu Afrika naseNdiya ukuze bakwazi ukubona izinkinga.
Babeqhuba izingxoxo nemihlangano yamaqembu nabasebenzi bezempilo, iziguli kanye namakhampani ezemishini yezokwelapha kusukela ngoSepthemba, 2012, kuya kuJuni, 2013, kuwo womabili amazwe.
Babuza ngezinqubo nezingqinamba ze-POC.

Esemphakathini wezempilo, eNdiya kusetshenziswa izilabhu ezincane eziningi futhi kwenziwa izivivinyo ezilula, kodwa izilabhu zazo azinikwa imali eyanele, ngakho-ke azinamakhambi anele okwenza ukuhlola.
Iziguli zivame ukutshelwa ukuba zibuyele ngelinye ilanga noma ziye kwenye indawo, okubangela izinkinga kubantu.
Abacwaningi baphawula futhi ukuthi ngezinye izikhathi iziguli zivivinywa kodwa kuthatha isikhathi eside ukuthi imiphumela ibuye, futhi bathola kunzima ukuthintana nodokotela wabo ngemva kwalokho.
Ababambiqhaza bathi kufanele kube nezindawo zokuhlola eziningi ezibhedlela, nokuthi ukuhlolwa kungenziwa endaweni efanayo lapho iziguli zingena khona.
Baphinde bathi ukulandelela, ukwelashwa noma ukwelulekwa kufanele kwenzeke endaweni efanayo.
ENingizimu Afrika, bathole ukuthi ezempilo yeningilizayo, inkampani eyodwa ilawula yonke imisebenzi yokuhlola, ngakho-ke izisampula ziya kule nkampani.
Ezinye izivivinyo ezilula zenziwa lapho kunakekelwa khona, futhi iziguli zithola imiphumela ngokushesha.
Ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ne-TB kuthatha isikhathi eside ngakho ukulandelela noma ukwelashwa kuphinde kulibale.
Ukubambezeleka okunye kungenxa yezinkinga zokuthutha, ukubhala amagama eziguli ngokungalungile, ukuphawula izisampula ngokungalungile, nokuwohloka kwamasistimu emakhompyutha.
Ekkuhlolweni kwe-HIV, ezinye izilabhu zasebenzisa izindlela ezahlukene zokuhlola, futhi lokhu kunikeza imiphumela engenakuthembwa.

Bathole ukuthi iziguli zizama ukuhlolwa kwe-HIV ngokuya ngobubanzi bendawo noma uhlobo lwe-test, futhi ngenxa yalokhu ngezinye izikhathi zisebenzisa ikhadi lokuhlonza elihlukile, okubangela izinkinga uma kuzama ukuthola imihlangano yokulandelela.
Abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi abasebenzi bezempilo kumele basebenzisane ukuze bahlanganyele umsebenzi.
Bathe uma kukhona amakiti amasha okuhlolwa kwe-HIV afika, abasebenzi kufanele baqeqeshwe kabusha futhi izinhlelo kufanele zivuselelwe.
Ababhali baqhathanise ulwazi lwe-POC oluvela kuwo womabili amazwe, futhi baphakamise ukuthi iziphathimandla kumele zihlole i-POC ngokufanele ngaphambi kokufaka imikhiqizo emisha noma amadivayisi.
Baphinda bathi kunesidingo sokwenza umzamo omkhulu ekusingatheni umsebenzi omkhulu ezikhungweni zokuhlola kanye nokuqonda indima esiguli elidlalayo ekunakekelweni kwempilo yaso.
Ababhali baleli phepha bebeqhamuka eNingizimu Afrika, eNdiya, eKhanada naseNetherlands.
Ukuya ekuchazeni ukugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa okubucayi usebenzisa ukuhlaziywa komqondo

Njengoba “ukugula okubucayi” ne-“ukunakekelwa okubucayi” kungabi nazichazelo ezihambisanayo, lo cwaningo luhlosile ukuhlola ukuthi imiqondo isebenza kanjani, lichaze izici zayo eziqondisa futhi liphakamise izincazelo ezingasebenza.
Sisebenzise indlela yokuhlaziya umqondo kaWalker no-Avant ngezinyathelo.
Ukusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kwemibono kutholwe ngokubuyekezwa kwesikophu kolwemibuzo ne-inhlolovo ye-inthanethi yochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangu-114 emhlabeni jikelele.
Ngokuhlaziya okuqukethwe kolwazi, sikhiphe amakhodi, izigaba nezindikimba ukuze simbe izimfanelo ezihlukanisayo zezinkonsepthi futhi sibeke izichazamazwi ezingasebenza.
Ukuze kusize ekuqondeni, sinikeza imodeli, amacala ahlobene nawo namaphambene mayelana nemibono, sibonile izimbangela nemiphumela yemibono, futhi saqondisa izinkomba zokulinganisa.

Izimpawu ezihlukanisayo zesifo esibucayi kwakuyingozi enkulu yokufa okusheshayo; ukungasebenzi kahle kwamalungu abalulekile; isidingo sokukhathalelwa ukuze kuvinjelwe ukufa; kanye nokubuyiselwa okungenzeka.

Izici ezihlukanisayo zokunakekelwa okubucayi kwakuwukubona, ukulandelela nokuphatha ukugula okubucayi; ukusekela izitho ezibalulekile; ukunakekelwa okuqala nokuqhubekayo; noma yikuphi ukunakekelwa kokugula okubucayi; kanye nemithombo yabantu nezinto ezikhethekile.

Uchazo lwethu oluphakanyisiwe lokugula okubucayi yilokhu: “simo sempilo embi esinekhuba ekuhlanganyeleni komzimba obalulekile, ingozi enkulu yokufa okusheshayo uma ukunakekelwa kungabi khona kanye nethuba lokubuyiselwa esimweni esijwayelekile”.
Uchazo lwethu oluphakanyisiwe lokunakekelwa okubucayi yilokhu: “ukubona, ukuqapha nokuphatha iziguli ezinegciwane elikhulu ngokusekela okuqala nokugcina imisebenzi yamalungu abalulekile.”
Imibono yokugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa okubucayi ayinawo amachaza-mvelo avumelana futhi isetshenziswa ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene.

Ngokuhlaziya imiqondo yokusetshenziswa kanye nezincazelo ezincwadini kanye kwabachwepheshe, siye sahlonzwa izici ezichaza imiqondo futhi siphakamisa izincazelo ezingasiza ukusebenza kwemithi, ucwaningo, kanye nokwenza izinqubomgomo.
Amandla Nezinkinga Zocwaningo
Lolu cwaningo lokuhlaziya imiqondo lungowokuqala ukuchaza ngendlela ehlelekile ukusetshenziswa nokucaciswa kwemiqondo yokugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa okubucayi.

Ucwaningo lusebenzisa ukubuyekezwa kwesikophu kolwemibuzo kanye nokufakwa kwemibono evela ochwepheshe bezokwelapha abangaphezu kwekhulu abavela ezindaweni ezihlukahlukene emhlabeni wonke ukuze kuhlonishwe izimpawu eziqondisa futhi kunikezwe incazelo ephakanyisiwe yemibono.
Kungenzeka ukuthi amanye amakhasi nezichazelo zemiqondo ngezilimi ezingaphandle kwesiNgisi, emibhalweni engashicilelwe nevela kubachwepheshe bezokwelapha abangafakwanga kulokhu kuphenyo, asilele.
Njengoba ukusetshenziswa kwamanje kwalezi zindlela kuhlukahlukene, izincazelo eziphakanyisiwe zingase zingamukeleki emhlabeni wonke futhi zihloselwe ukukhuthaza ingxoxo eyengeziwe.
Abacwaningi bahlela kabusha incazelo yokuqondwa kweziguli “ezigula kakhulu” nokuphathwa kwazo.
Izinkomba eziqondile zokunakekelwa kwesiguli ezisetshenziswa emhlabeni jikelele ngabo bonke odokotela zingasiza ekunakekelweni kwesiguli esigula kakhulu.
Kulesifundo, iqembu lamazwe ngamazwe labacwaningi liphakamisa ukuthi “ukugula okubucayi” kufanele kusho ukuthi ngenkathi isiguli esigula sinenhlanhla enkulu yokushona, singaphinda siphulukane.

Baphinda bathi “ukunakekelwa” okunikezwa iziguli ezigula kakhulu kufanele kusho noma yiluphi unakekelwa olunikezwa kusukela ezikhathini lapho zifika esibhedlela, kwaze kwaba yilapho zifa noma ziphulukile.
Akufanele nje kuphawule ukunakekelwa okusebenzisa imishini ekhethekile.
Esibhedlela, odokotela bavame ukubhekisela kubantu abagulayo kakhulu ngokuthi “abagulayo kakhulu”, kanti ukunakekelwa nokwesekwa okudingekayo kulaba ziguli kubizwa ngokuthi “ukunakekelwa okubucayi”.
Kodwa-ke, odokotela abasebenza ezingxenyeni ezahlukene noma ezibhedlela baqonda la magama ngokuhlukile, ngoba incazelo yawo ihlukahlukene endaweni ngayinye.
Lokhu kuholela, isibonelo, ezigulini ezinezimpawu ezifanayo zithola ukwelashwa okungafani noma ukunakekelwa, kuye ngokuthi ubani ozisiza.
Amakhambi ahlukene enza kube nzima ngohulumeni ukwazi inani langempela lezimpoqo ezimbi ezweni labo.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baqale bahlaziya ukuthi odokotela abahlukene bahlukanisa kanjani “ukugula okukhulu” no “kunakekelwa okukhulu”, bese bephakamisa amachazamazwi ahlelekile.
Baqoqe ulwazi ngokubuyekeza ezinye izindatshana ezinyathelisiwe.
Baphinde baxoxisana nodokotela abavela emazweni ambalwa ahlukahlukene emhlabeni ababenolwazi lokwelapha iziguli ezigula kakhulu.

Abaphenyi babhala ngezincazelo ezahlukene zezifo ezibucayi, futhi baphawula ukuthi kwakuxhunyaniswe ngokuvamile nethuba elikhulu lokufa kwabaguli; amanye amalungu omzimba angasebenzi; isidingo sokukhathalelwa ukuze kugwenywe ukufa; kanye nethuba lokuphulukana.

Ngokuphathelene nokufa nokubuyela esimweni esiqondile, amanye amachaza-mvelo abonisa ukuthi bonke abagulayo abanesimo esibi bayofa ekugcineni, kanti amanye abonisa ithuba lokuthi isiguli singaphila naphezu kokuba nesimo esibi.

Ekugcineni, abaphenyi baphakamisa ukuchaza ukugula okubucayi njengokugula lapho amalungu omzimba ayeka khona ukusebenza, lapho kunesilinganiso esiphezulu sokuthi isiguli singafa uma singanakekelwa kahle, kodwa kunethuba lokuphulukana.
Mayelana nokukhathalelwa okubalulekile, odokotela babonakala bekuchaza ngokufanayo kakhulu, kodwa bahluke ngokuthi ukunakekelwa okunjalo kufanele kunikezwe kuphi, nesidingo semishini ekhethekile.
Ezinye imithombo yathi ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kungenzeka kuphela ezindaweni ezithile ezikhethekile esibhedlela esinezinto zokusebenza ezikhethekile.
Abanye bacabanga ukuthi ukunakekelwa okukhethekile kungafaka ukusebenzisa izinsiza ezikhethekile, kodwa kwakungeyona imfuneko.
Bathe bathi ukunakekelwa okukhulu kungaphanwa ngisho nasemagumbini avamile, ezikhungweni ezincane zezempilo, emphakathini noma ezigulini.
Bathe bathi ngisho nasezindaweni ezihlwempuzekile, iziguli ezigula kakhulu zazidinga ukunakekelwa okukhethekile.

Ngakho-ke abacwaningi baphakamise ukuthi ukunakekelwa okubucayi kungachazwa njengonke ukunakekelwa okutholwe yiziguli ezinegciwane elikhulu kusukela ekuqaleni kokubona ochwepheshe bezempilo ukuze bathole iseluleko kuze kube yilapho zifa noma ziphulukile.

Abacwaningi bathi lolu kwakuwuhlobo lokuqala locwaningo oluqoqe ulwazi ngezichazamazwi ezahlukene zokugula okubucayi nokunakekelwa, nokuthi imiphumela yabo izosisiza ukuthuthukisa ukunakekelwa kwabantu abagulayo kakhulu.
Nokho bathi ucwaningo lwabo lungase lukhawulelwe yiqiniso lokuthi abazange basebenzise amachazamazwi avela kwezinye izilimi ngaphandle kwesiNgisi noma emithonjeni engashicilelwe.
Baphinda baxoxisana nodokotela abavela kwamanye amazwe ambalwa kuphela, ngakho-ke ukuhlaziya kwabo akubameli wonke amazwe emhlabeni.
Abacwaningi, ababevela emanyuvesi aseMalawi, eTanzania, eSweden nase-UK, bathi imibhalo yabo ephakanyisiwe ingashintshwa uma kudingeka.
Isikrini se-genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 sibonisa i-CENPJ njengomlawuli womsingathi wokuhlelelwa okuguqukile kwe-microtubule ngesikhathi sokutheleleka kwe-Plasmodium e-liver.
Ngaphambi kokuthi kuqale umalaleveva onempawu, i-Plasmodium sporozoite eyodwa iyathinta i-hepatocyte bese ikhula ibe izinkulungwane ze-merozoites, ngokusebenzisa izinto ezivela emzimbeni womsingathi.
Sikhomba ukuthi ama-microtubules omsimathisi ahlela kabusha ngendlela eguqukayo eduze kwesidlagazi esikhulayo sesigaba se-liver (LS).

Sisebenzisa i-genome-wide CRISPR-Cas9 screen, sibonile abalawuli bomsingathi benhlangano ye-cytoskeleton, ukuthutha kwe-vesicle, ukucindezeleka kwe-ER/Golgi kanye nokwenziwa kwe-lipid okulawula ukuthuthukiswa kwe-Plasmodium LS.
Lezi zilawuli ezintsha zokutheleleka, kuhlanganise i-Centromere Protein J (CENPJ), zisibonise ukubuza ukuthi ama-microtubule organizing centers (MTOCs) alawulwa kanjani ngesikhathi sokutheleleka.
Amaphuzu e-γ-tubulin abekwe emaphethelweni esidlagazi; ukunciphisa i-CENPJ kwakhuphula leli lungiselelo futhi kwandisa ukutheleleka.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, sibonisa ukuthi i-Golgi isebenza njenge-MTOC engasisona i-centrosomal ngokuhlela i-γ-tubulin nokukhuthaza ukwakheka kwe-microtubule emaphethelweni esidlagazi.

Ngokuphelele, sibonisa ukuthi i-Plasmodium LS iqasha i-Golgi yomsingathi ukwakha izikhonkwane ezisetshenziswa yi-MT lapho ama-organelles omzimba omkhulu eqoqwa khona ku-PVM, ukuze kusekelwe ukuthuthukiswa kwesigaba sokwelashwa.
Umphumela wethu ubonisa ukuthi abavimbi abaningi bemithi abahlose umsingathi bangavimba ukutheleleka kwe-LS.
Ososayensi bayafunda ukuthi umalaleveva uwahlukumeza kanjani amangqamuzana ukuze bafumane izindlela ezintsha zokwelapha.
Izilwanyana eziningi ezithwala izifo zisebenzisa izakhamzimba kanye nemithombo yamasiko ezicubu zomsingathi wazo, omuntu noma isilwane, ukuze ziphinde zivelane.

Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi bathole ufuzo oluthile oluhilelekile ekuthelelekeni komalaleveva ezicini zesibindi, okungase kuholele ezicushwini ezintsha zezidakamizwa zokulwa nomalaleveva esikhathini esizayo.
Umalaleveva uyisifo esisakazekile futhi esingaba yingozi eyingozi ebangelwa yi-Plasmodium parasite, esithwalwa ngokuluma komiyane.

Lapho i-Plasmodium ingena emzimbeni, iyalungela ngqo e-zibindini ukuze izalise - le nqophamlando yokuqala ilungele ukwelashwa komalaleveva ngoba ayikho izimpawu zokugula okwamanje futhi leli gciwane alikwazi ukudluliselwa.
Kulesifundo, abacwaningi bafuna ukubona izinguquko ezithile zofuzo namaprotheni emasosheni esibindi athelekile ngamagciwane, ezingashintsha indlela ukutheleleka kuqhubeka ngayo.
Besebenzisa ubuchwepheshe bokuguqula ufuzo i-CRISPR-Cas9, abacwaningi bakwazile ukucima noma “ukukhipha” izakhi ezithile zofuzo ukuze babone ukuthi kwenzekani lapho lezo zakhi zofuzo zingasebenzi.
Babe sebethulele ama-cells e-liver avamile “na-knocked out” ngezimuncagazi zomlalaleveva.

Lezi zakhiwo ezifana nepayipi zibandakanyeka, phakathi kwezinye izinto, ekuhambeni kwezakhamzimba nezinto ngaphakathi kwamasosha omzimba, futhi ngokuvamile zakha inethiwekhi eduze kwesizinda senkombafuzo.

Esinye sezinto ezibalulekile ezitholakele ukuthi i-Plasmodium ithatha ama-microtubules asemaseleni e-liver - esikhundleni sokuba ama-microtubules ahlangane eduze kwesisinda senkombafuzo, ahambise izakhamzimba nezinto lapho iseli ikudingayo, ama-microtubules ahlangane eduze kwesidlagazi, ahambise izakhamzimba nezinto ukuze kusize isidlagazi ukuzala.

Abacwaningi babona ukuthi lapho beqeda iprotheni ebizwa nge-CENPJ, isidlagazi saba siphumelela kakhulu ekuqoqeni ama-microtubule ezungeze lona, futhi izidlagazi zakhula zabe zenza amakhophi amaningi azo.
Izazi zesayensi zithole futhi ezinye izakhi zofuzo eziningi ezinomthelela ezingeni lokubhubha komalaleveva.
Abacwaningi bakhombise ngaphambili ukuthi ezinye izidlagazi zihlanganisa kabusha ama-microtubules ukuze ziguqule izinto eziphilayo ngaphakathi kweseli ziye kuzo.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi baqinisekisile ukuthi izidligazi ze-Plasmodium zingase futhi zisebenzise le ngqondo ukuqondisa kabusha izakhamzimba nezinye izinto eziwusizo ekukhuleni kwazo.
Kusasa, ososayensi bathemba ukusebenzisa ukuqonda kwabo ukuthi ufuzo nezidlagazi zihlangana kanjani emagumbini eselini ukuthola ukwelapha okusha komalaleveva.

Nakuba abacwaningi bathole izinguquko ezithakazelisayo emapuroteni asezingqamuzaneni zesibindi ezingxenyeni zokuqala zomlaleveva, kunesidingo somsebenzi omningi ukuqonda ukuthi i-Plasmodium iyiguqula kanjani ikhemikhali kanye nomsebenzi wezingqamuzana ukuze okuqondiwe kwezidakamizwa kuqondwe.
Amakhulu ezinkulungwane zokufa kusenelile unyaka ngamunye ngenxa yomalaleveva, inani elikhulu lawo lise-Afrika.

Ngokusho kweQembu Lezempilo Lomhlaba, ngaphezulu kuka-90% yezigameko zomhlaba jikelele zikamalaleveva ngo-2019 zenzeka e-Afrika, okwenza lokhu kube yindaba ebalulekile edinga imizamo eqhubekayo yokulawula nokungenelela.
Ukuhlasela kwe-Biological njengengxenye Yomzamo Wezwe Lonke Wocwaningo Lweguquko eNingizimu Afrika
Kulesi sahluko, siqhathanisa ukuthi ucwaningo olungakanani eNingizimu Afrika luqondiswe ekuhlaselweni kwemvelo uma kuqhathaniswa namanye amanye amakhono ashintsho lomhlaba.

Sisebenzisa i-Web of Science, sibuyekeze ngendlela ehlelekile izincwadi ezifanele zezemvelo zaseNingizimu Afrika ezinyatheliswe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 futhi ezihlobene nokuhlasela kwe-biological, inguquko yobunjalozwe, ukuqothulwa ngokweqile, ukuguquka kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa, kanye/noma i-atmospheric CO2.
Sithole amaphepha afanele angu-1149 aphumelelwe ngokwemigomo yabo yokumboza abashayeli kanye nokuqondana kwabashayeli okunethelela ekuhlaleni komhlaba noma izinsizakalo ze-ecosystem.
Kutholwe umphumela oqine we-spatio-temporal emzamweni wocwaningo.

Okokuqala, umzamo wahlukana phakathi kwezindawo, ngokushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, ukungcoliswa nokudla ngokweqile okuthola ukugxila okukhulu kocwaningo emazingeni omphakathi, amanzi amnandi nolwandle/umfula ngokulandelana.
Okwesibili, izimpawu ezithile ezifundwe kahle emhlabeni azibhalwanga emibhalweni yendawo (isibonelo kwakunemiqulu engaphansi kwehlanu mayelana nokukhuluphala kolwandle).

Sithole ukusebenzisana okuhlukene okungu-21 phakathi kwabaqhubi, lapho ukusebenzisana phakathi kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo kanye noshintsho lwendawo okuhlala kuyo (isibonelo izinguquko zemikhuba yomlilo ezindaweni ezihlaselekile) kuyinto evelele kakhulu.
Nokho, okungenani u-4% kuphela wezincwadi ezikhuluma ngokusebenzisana phakathi kwabashayeli abathathu noma ngaphezulu.

Lokhu kusikisela ukuthi ngenkathi kubalulekile ukuqonda ukusebenzisana kwabashayeli, kuncane kakhulu ucwaningo olukhona mayelana nemiphumela ehlanganisiwe yokusebenzisana kwabashayeli ezindaweni zaseNingizimu Afrika.

Isikhathi eside kuye kwashiwo ukuthi izinhlobo ezihlaselayo ziyingozi yesibili enkulu kunazo zonke ekulondolozeni ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo, ngemuva kokuguquka komkhakha, kufana nokuphuma kwemiphumela yocwaningo olukhulu ngalesi sizathu eNingizimu Afrika.

Ukuthola isithombe esibanzi sokubalwa kwemiphumela yokuqhubela phambili komhlaba kuzoba inselele, hhayi kuphela ekuhlukaniseni okucacile kwabaqhubi, kodwa futhi ngenxa yokungalingani kokutholakala kwemiphumela yocwaningo ezingeni elifanayo ngokwendawo nangesikhathi.
Ukuvuthwa okuthile komsebenzi mayelana nezinhlobo zezilwane ezihlaselayo kungaba yisisekelo sokuphenya ukusebenzelana okunjalo okunzima, futhi ngaleyo ndlela kusize ekuqedeni izithiyo ezinjalo.
Abacwaningi kumele benze imephu yemiphumela ehlangene yezinhlobo ezihlaselayo, inguquko yobunjalozwe nemisebenzi yabantu eNingizimu Afrika.
Izinhlobo ezihlaselayo yingozi yesibili enkulu ekulondolozeni ukwahlukahluka kwemvelo eNingizimu Afrika - iqiniso elihambisana, kusho abacwaningi, nenani lezincwadi zocwaningo ezenziwe ngale ndaba.
Lokhu kuhambelana nezinye izinsongo ezifana nokungcoliswa, inguquko yobunjalozwe, ukuqothulwa ngokweqile noma ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala.

Lezi zinsongo zezemvelo yilokho ososayensi abakubiza ngokuthi izimbangi zokushintsha komhlaba wonke, okuyisifundo sendlela uMhlaba, njengesimiso, oshintsha ngayo ngokusebenzelana konke phakathi kwemisebenzi yabantu nezinye izinqubo zokwenyama, zekhemikhali nezobiological.

Esahlukweni sencwadi yakamuva, abacwaningi bahlole ukuthi kuncwaningwe kangakanani eNingizimu Afrika ngokuhlala kwezilwane nezitshalo ezingaphandle, lapho izinhlobo zezitshalo noma izilwane zifakwa endaweni entsha lapho zikhula khona, zimi khona futhi zingaze zenze ubuhlungu kwezinye izinhlobo ezizungezile noma emvelweni.
Baphinda babheka ucwaningo lokuthi lo mshayeli uhlangana kanjani nabanye abashayeli.
Bebheka emaphephandabeni ocwaningo ashiciwe phakathi kuka-2000 no-2018 ku-database ye-“Web of Science”, bathole izifundo ezifanele eziyi-1149.

Ukuhlola kwabo izifundo kwabonisa ukuthi ucwaningo olusekelwe ezweni (olwasemhlabeni) lugxile kakhulu ekuthuthukeni kwendawo yokuhlala, kuyilapho ucwaningo lwamanzi amnandi lugxile ekungcoliseni, kanti ucwaningo lolwandle nelugxile emilonyeni lugxile kakhulu ekukutshelweni ngokweqile.
Baphinde bathola ukuthi izinto ezibhalwe kahle emhlabeni wonke ukuthi zithinta ukuhlukahluka kwemvelo noma izinsiza ze-ecosystem, azibhalwanga kahle eziphandeni zaseNingizimu Afrika.
Isibonelo, bathole amaphepha amahlanu kuphela abheka i-acidification yolwandle, ephazamisa izinhlangano zokudla futhi olimaza impilo yolwandle.
Lokhu kwenzeka ngoba i-carbon dioxide eyongeziwe emoyeni, evela emisebenzini yabantu njengokushisa izibaso ezimbiwa phansi, iyachitheka emanzini olwandle.
Ukushintsha kwendawo yokuhlala, njengomlilo noma inguquko yobunjalozwe, kuholela ekukhuleni kwezinhlobo ezihlaselayo.
Bathe ukuthi ikhabhoni dayoksayidi ikhuphuke ngamaphesenti angaba ngu-40%, futhi kungenzeka ukuthi idala izimo ezinhle kakhulu zokukhula kwezitshalo zangaphandle.
Kodwa, kunocwaningo oluncane kakhulu oluyenziwe ngale ndaba eNingizimu Afrika.
Bathole amaphepha angu-21 abheka indlela abashayeli abahlukene abaxhumana ngayo.
Iningi lalezi zazigxile ekuxhumaniseni izinguquko zezindawo zokuhlala nezinhlobo ezihlaselayo.
Kodwa, izincwadi ezimbalwa kakhulu zibheke abashayeli abangu-3 noma ngaphezulu ngesikhathi esifanayo.
Ababhali bathi lokhu kusikisela ukuthi ucwaningo olwengeziwe mayelana nendlela abashayeli bokuwohloka komhlaba abasebenzisana ngayo ukuthinta ezemvelo luyadingeka eNingizimu Afrika.

Ababhali baseNingizimu Afrika bayavuma ukuthi kuyoba nzima ukuthola umbono ophelele wokuthi abashayeli bezinguquko zomhlaba banxibelelana kanjani eNingizimu Afrika, kodwa bathi ucwaningo lwendawo olukhona ngezinhlobo ezihlaselayo selungase luqondise izifundo kule ndawo eyingxube-xube.
Izici ze-edaphic ezilawula izinto eziphilayo ezingumhlabathi kanye nokugcinwa kwe-C ehlathini laseMiombo, eZambia
Izinto eziphilayo ezingaphansi komhlabathi (SOM) yingxenye ebalulekile yokukhiqiza kwamahlathi kanye nesitoko se-carbon ezingaphansi komhlabathi.
Kodwa, kuncane okwaziwayo mayelana nokuhlukahluka kwe-SOM ne-C ehlathini laseMiombo, eliyisiko-mfumo elikhulu ehlathini lase-Afrika esingaphansi kweSahara futhi libalulekile ezindleleni ze-REDD+.
Kulesifundo, izici ezingu-9 zenhlabathi zalinganiswa futhi zasetshenziswa ukuhlaziya ukungafani kweSOM ezindaweni zasehlathini laseMiombo ezinezakhiwo ezahlukene zezihlahla eLuanshya, eZambia.
Imiphumela ikhombise ukungafani okukhulu kwamalawu e-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukene komhlabathi:

Kusukela ku-36.67 kuya ku-113.89 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni kuka-0-10 cm, kusukela ku-28.67 kuya ku-79.56 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni kuka-10-20 cm, kanye nokusukela ku-31.89 kuya ku-98.56 Mg ha-1 ekujuleni kuka-20-30 cm.

Lezi zindinganiso ze-SOM ekujuleni okuhlukene nazo zahlukahluka ezindaweni zasehlathini laseMiombo ezigabeni ezahlukene zokulandelana, ikakhulukazi ukuthi izindawo ezithintekile yisusiwe samithi zakamuva zazinezinga eliphezulu le-SOM ngezingqimba (+5.57% ku-0-10 cm; +4.20% ku-10-20 cm; +4.30% ku-20-30 cm).
Ukuhlaziywa kokufana okubalulekile (i-CCA) kwembule ukuthi izici ezibaluleke kakhulu zemvelo eziphazamisa i-SOM kwakuwukuncishiswa kwehlathi ngokuhlanzwa, kanye nokuqukethwe komhlabathi ongamakhaza.

Ucwaningo olu luqokomisa ukuthi i-CCA ingasetshenziswa ukubonisa ukubaluleka okulinganiselwe kwezinyathelo ezahlukene zokukhula kwamahlathi njengomsebenzi wezindlela zokuphatha, kanye nezici ze-edaphic, ekutholeni okuqukethwe kwe-SOM yomhlabathi we-miombo.

Imiphumela yalolu cwaningo ibaluleke kakhulu ekubhekaneni neqhinga lamanje le-REDD+ lokutshala amahlathi kabusha nokuphathwa kwawo okuqondiswe ekwandiseni izitoreji zekhabhoni emahlathini afudumele ase-Afrika esezansi nesahara.
Sithi ososayensi abafunda amahlathi aseZambia, qothulani imithi ngokucophelela ukuthuthukisa inhlabathi.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ezisusiwe ihlathi nezinhlabathi eziphezulu ehlathini laseZambia zazinamakha e-organic amaningi, okusho ukuthi umhlabathi ukhulu kangcono.
Kubalulekile ukuqonda ikhwalithi yomhlabathi e-zansi nesahara ngoba ithonya kakhulu indlela izitshalo nezihlahla ezikhula ngayo.
Inhlabathi inezakhamzimba ezahlukene, futhi izinto eziphilayo nezilimo yizona ezibaluleke kakhulu ekusizini izitshalo ukukhula.
Izinto eziphilayo yizinhanganisela ezisemhlabathini ezivela ezinsalelweni zezitshalo nezilwane ezifile.
Ngaphezu kwengxenye (58%) yento ephilayo yikhabhoni nje, bese okunye yimanzi nezinye izakhamzimba.
Inhlabathi enezinto eziphilayo eziningi, futhi ngaleyo ndlela ikhabhoni, igcina amanzi isikhathi eside futhi inezinye izakhamzimba eziningi.
Ososayensi abanawo ulwazi oluningi ngezinguquko zezinto eziphilayo nekhaboni enhlabathini yase-Afrika yasezansi nesahara, ngisho noma kubalulekile kakhulu ekukhuleni kwemifino nezihlahla.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuthola ukuthi izinto eziphilayo emhlabathini ehlathini ziguqukile kanjani, nokuthi yini eqinisa inani lazo.
Bawenzile ucwaningo lwabo ehlathini laseZambia.
Baqoqe amasampula enhlabathi ezingeni eliphezulu (0-10 cm), eliphakathi (10-20 cm), nelijulile (20-30 cm), nakwezinye izindawo zasehlathini.
Bese abacwaningi bahlola lawomahlabathi elabhoratri ukuze bahlole ukuthi inawo malini amakhemikhali emvelo.
Ilebhu iyisakhiwo lapho ososayensi benza khona ama-test nama-experiment, ngokuvamile besebenzisa imishini enembile yokulinganisa imingcele ethile.
Baphinde babhala phansi ezinye izimfanelo zenhlabathi njengohlobo lwayo, ngokwesibonelo isihlabathi noma elinjengobumba.
Imiphumela yabo ibonise ukuthi inani le-organic matter lahlukene kakhulu ezindaweni ezahlukene, nasemazingeni ahlukene.
Umhlabathi ophezulu wawunezinto eziphilayo eziphakeme kakhulu ezingafika kuma-milligrams angu-114 (mg) ehektare, olandwe ngumhlabathi ojulile (cishe ama-mg angu-100 ngehektare).
Umhlabathi ophakathi wawunezinga eliphansi kakhulu elalingafika kuma-80 mg ngehektha.
Abacwaningi bathi izindawo ehlathini ezazisanda kuhlanzwa zazinezinto eziphilayo eziningi kunezindawo ezingakahlanzwa.
Bathi ukuthungatha izimithi ehlathini, ngokuphathwa okucophelelayo, ngaleyo ndlela kungandisa izinto eziphilayo emhlabathini.

Abacwaningi baphawula futhi ukuthi umbala wenhlabathi washintsha ukusuka obhentsheni obukhulu (umhlabathi ophezulu) uya kobhentsheni obukhanyayo (-julile), nokuthi inhlabathi yensihlabathi nebumba yayinento eningi ephilayo.
Izindawo ehlathini ezazivulekele ukukhanya kwelanga zazinezimithi ezinkulu nezingamadala, kanye nezinto eziphilayo eziningi.
Abacwaningi, ababehlala eZambiya naseNingizimu Afrika, bathi izindlela zabo zingaguqulwa abanye ukuhlola ikhwalithi yomhlabathi ezindaweni ezahlukene nasemazingeni ahlukene.
Ukuthuthukisa Ukukhiqizwa Kwekhipshi nokukhiqiza Ngokusebenzisa Indlela Yenkundla Yomqondo Yababambe Iqhaza e-Ethiopia
I-chikiphi (Cicer arietinum L.) yiyona leginimu yesithathu ebalulekile kokubili ngendawo kanye nokukhiqizwa ngemuva kwababhontshisi abavamile kanye nababhontshisi basefaba e-Ethiopia.
Kodwa-ke, ukukhiqiza kwesitshalo kwakuphakathi kakhulu uma kuqhathaniswa namandla awo ngenxa yokungasetshenziswa kwezinhlobo ezithuthukisiwe kanye nezobuchwepheshe ezidalwe yisikhungo sokuqeqesha.

Ukuthuthukisa ukusetshenziswa kwezobuchwepheshe obuthuthukisiwe nobuhlobene nocwaningo, kwamiswa i-National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform ngo-2013, ngenhloso yokubuthana ababambe iqhaza abahlukahlukene abasebenza ochungechungeni lokukhiqiza ukuze kuhlonishwe izinselelo ezinkulu futhi kutholakale izixazululo ezizosetshenziswa ngemizamo ehlangene.
Ipulatifomu ibonise ukushoda kwembewu njengesiqondisi esikhulu kulesi siza.
Le nkinga iye yakhonjiswa ngokwakhiwa kwamabutho abalimi abakhiqizi bembewu ngosizo lwabalingani be-R&D, futhi okwamanje yibona abahlinzeki abakhulu ezweni lonke.
Bese behlangene, leli qonga liye laqina umzamo wokwandisa futhi laqalisa ukusakazwa kwezobuchwepheshe ezithuthukisiwe kubalimi abaningi.
Ngenxa yalokho, ukukhiqizwa kwezitshalo zabalimi abasebenzisa amamodeli kwanda kakhulu kane, futhi ukukhiqizwa kwesizwe kuphindwe kabili kuya ku-2 ton ha−1 kuleli shumi leminyaka eledlule.
Le nkundla iphinde yasebenza ekulungiseni ukufinyelela emakethe futhi muva nje i-chickpea ijoyine imakethe ye-Ethiopian Commodity Exchange.
Inama-platform, iqaphela amathuba amakhulu okukhula alo mbewu, lizindla ngokwenza ukungenelela kuqine kakhulu futhi kuzuze amathuba.
Indlela i-Ethiopia ekhuphule ngayo ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda.

Abacwaningi bachaze ukuthi i-Ethiopia yandisile kanjani ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda ngokuqinisekisa ukuthi abalimi banokufinyelela ezimbewini ezithuthukisiwe kanye nokuqeqeshwa ngezindlela zokulima ezithuthukisiwe.
I-chikiphi isitshalo sokudla esifana nebhontshisi esitshalwa kakhulu eTopiya.
Iningi lemikhiqizo yezwe lithunyelwa kwamanye amazwe.
Eminyakeni eminingi edlule, abantu abaningi baqaphela ukuthi abalimi bangakhiqiza amantongomane amaningi uma besebenzisa imbewu ethuthukisiwe engamelana nezinambuzane nezifo.
Incwadi yakamuva ibhala ngendlela ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda ase-Ethiopia kuye kwanda kusukela kulokho kuqondwa.
Ababhali bathi ngo-2013, i-Ethiopia yakha i-“National Chickpea Stakeholders Innovation Platform” eyaxoxa ngezinkinga ekukhiqizweni kwamatshwele futhi yaveza izixazululo.
Inkundla ifana nenhlangano.
Ipulatifomu yayifaka abacwaningi, uMnyango wezoLimo wase-Ethiopia, amaqembu abalimi kanye nezinhlangano, abenzi bokudla, abakhiqizi bembewu, nabalingani bokuthumela kwamanye amazwe.
Ababhali bathi isiteji sabona ukushoda kwembewu njengesinselelo esikhulu, bese bakha izinhlangano zokunikeza imbewu kulo lonke izwe.
Lokhu kushintsha kwandisa ukukhiqizwa kwamaqanda kabili kwaze kwaba yiyithani ezimbili ngehektha.
Omunye umsebenzi ababewubone yikulingana eliphansi lomkhiqizo.
Baqeqesha abalimi ngezindlela zokukhiqiza ezingcono, njengokusebenzisa umquba ukuthuthukisa ikhwalithi yomhlabathi.
Baphawule futhi ukuthi abalimi bahlupheka ukulawula ukhula.

Ngakho-ke banika abalimi imbewu yebhontshisi elikwazi ukukhula kahle ngisho nalapho liphuzwe ngekhemikhali yokubulala ukhula, ezingamakemikhali abalimi abawasebenzisayo ukulawula ukhula noma izitshalo ezingafuneki.
Ababhali bathi iplatform yenza isiqiniseko sokuthi abalimi baqeqeshwa ukwandisa ulwazi lwabo ekukhiqizweni kwamaqanda.
Abalimi nabo babeya emihlanganweni lapho bebengahlanganyela khona ulwazi namava abo.
Ababhali bathi i-platform ihlanganise abalimi nabathengi, kanye nabakhiqizi bembewu nalabo ababophekile ekuthengeni nasekusabalaliseni imbewu kubalimi.
Leli qembu liphinde laqamba laqeqesha amaqembu abesifazane nabasha ngokukhiqizwa kwamaqanda.
Baphinda bakhuthaza abesifazane nabasha ukuba babe yingxenye ekukhiqizweni kwezimbewu.
Ababhali bathi naphezu kokuthi kufezwe okuningi, kusasekhona ukushoda kwembewu yebhinya.
Baphinde bathi le nkundla ingazuza okwengeziwe uma ngabe babe nezinto eziyisiza ukuhlangana njalo.
Baphakamisa ukuthi uMnyango wezoLimo wase-Ethopia nabacwaningi kufanele basekele iplatifomu ngemali ukuze ingawi.
Baphinde basekele ukuthuthukiswa kokulingana kwamaqanda kanye nendlela okuqondwa ngayo ingozi yokukhiqiza amaqanda, njengezifo.
Ekugcineni, ababhali babize ukuba kube khona imbewu ethuthukisiwe eyokwazi ukuvunwa kalula ngemishini, futhi engathinteki yikhemikhali yokubulala ukhula.
Uhlobo oluhlukile lwe-SARS-CoV-2 lineage A (A.23.1) olunezinguquko zespaki luvele futhi lubusa okwamanje isifo sika-Uganda.

Nakuba izinguquko eziqondile ze-A.23.1 njengoba iziqondanise zihlukile kwezinguquko ze-variants of concern (VOC), ukuziphendukela kwemvelo kubonisa ukuhlangana kusethi efanayo yamaprotheni.

Isifunda sokukodwa kwe-A.23.1 spike protein siqoqele izinguquko ezifana neziningi zezinguquko ezibonwe ku-VOC kuhlanganise nenguquko esikhundleni 613, inguquko esizindeni sokuhlukanisa i-furin esandisa i-motif ye-amino acid esiqinile, kanye nezinye izinguquko eziningi esizindeni se-N-terminal esenza imisebenzi yokulwa nezifo.
Ngaphezu kwalokho, i-A.23.1 lineage iqukethe izinguquko kumaprotheni angeyona i-spike amanye ama-VOC abonisa (i-nsp6, i-ORF8 ne-ORF9).

Umphumela walokhu kuguquka kwe-A.23.1 kwempilo yabantu awukaqondakala, kodwa kubalulekile ukuqhubeka nokuqapha ngokucophelela lokhu kuguquka, kanye nokulinganisa ngokushesha imiphumela yezinguquko ze-spike protein ekusebenzakahle komgomo.
Abacwaningi babika ngokuguquka kwe-SARS-CoV-2 e-Uganda.
Ngo-2021, abacwaningi babike ukuthi uhlobo olusha lwe-SARS-CoV-2, igciwane elibangela i-Covid-19, luqubuke e-Uganda, lwasabalala kwamanye amazwe angu-26.
Balibiza leli hlobo ngokuthi “A.23.1”, bathi linezinguquko eziningi ezifanayo zamaprotheni abacwaningi abazibonile kwezinye izinhlobo ezibalulekile emhlabeni jikelele ngalesi sikhathi.
Oosayensi balandela indlela izinhlobo zekhuvethe ezishintsha ngayo ukuze baqonde kangcono ukuthi imigomo ingase isebenze kahle kangakanani ezinhlotsheni ezintsha.
I-Covid-19 ibulele abantu abaningi emhlabeni wonke.
Enqubweni eyaziwa ngokuthi ukubhekwa kwe-genomic, ososayensi baqapha indlela i-genetics namaprotheni egciwane ashintsha ngayo njengoba isabalala.
Bayasebenzisa lolu lwazi ukuze baphathe isifo futhi baqondise ukuthuthukiswa komgomo.
Ngokwesibonelo, ngokuqonda ubukhulu be-spike protein yegciwane, abacwaningi bangakwazi ukwakha imigomo ehlomula kangcono lezo protein ukuze kuvimbelwe igciwane ukungena kumaseli omzimba womuntu.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babheke ngokukhethekile indlela i-SARS-CoV-2 eyaluphuhluka ngayo e-Uganda.
Abacwaningi baqonde izakhi zofuzo zegciwane ezingeni isampula ze-COVID-19 ezaqoqwa kulo lonke elase-Uganda.

Basebenzisa isofthiwe yekhompyutha ukuze balandele umlando (noma umlando womndeni) wohlobo olusha abalutholile ngale ndlela (oluthiwa yi-A.23.1), futhi bakwazi ukubona ukuthi uhlobo luhambisana kanjani nomuthi womndeni we-SARS-CoV-2.
Imiphumela yabo iveze ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 luye lwathuthuka muva nje kwenye uhlobo oluthiwa yi-A.23, futhi lwatholwa ku-90% yazo zonke izisampula ezitholakele zinegciwane.
Ngamanye amazwi, bekuyilawula isampula zase-Uganda kusukela ngo-Okthoba 2020.
Baphethe futhi ukuthi uhlobo lwe-A.23.1 lwalunezinguquko eziningi eprotheni ye-spike ezifana nezinguquko ezibonwe kwezinye izinhlobo ezibalulekile.
Lezi zinguquko cishe zenza leli hlobo le-virus lisabalale kalula (lisabalala ngokushesha), futhi libe namandla okulwa nemigomo kanye nezinye izindlela zokwelapha.
Lolu cwaningo lwenza igalelo emizamweni eqhubekayo yokulandelana kwezinhlobo ze-SARS-CoV-2 emhlabeni jikelele.
Imiphumela ibekezelela ubufakazi obukhula bokuthi i-SARS-CoV-2 ithuthuka ngokushesha njengoba isakazeka ukuze ibekezelele abantu abaningi futhi igweme imigomo.
Kodwa-ke, ucwaningo olwengeziwe luyadingeka ukuqonda ukuthi yini ngempela imiphumela noma imisebenzi yezinguquko ze-spike protein e-A.23.1.
Abacwaningi batuse ukubhekwa okuningi kwe-genomic ukuze kusisize siqonde ukuthi izinhlobo zegciwane ziphendula kanjani emigomweni etholakala e-Uganda nakwamanye amazwe.
Baphinde bathi ukuqapha uhambo lwamazwe ngamazwe kubalulekile ukuze abacwaningi baqonde kangcono ukuthi i-virus isabalala kanjani endaweni.
Yini Eyenza Uwesifazane?
Izifundo Zezimo Zombili Zichaza Izizathu Nezimpawu Zokuhlukunyezwa Kwezilwane Zabesifazane/Ukusika e-Indonesia, e-Ethiopia nase-Kenya
Ukugqoka/ukusika izitho zangasese zesifazane kuyindlela yokudala elimaza futhi ephula amalungelo abesifazane, futhi inezingozi zezempilo.
Lolu phepha libonisa izizathu nezimo zokusikwa kwezilwane zangasese zesifazane (FGM/C) ezindaweni ezithile zamazwe amathathu – i-Indonesia, iTopiya neKenya.

Ulwazi luqoqwe ngenhlolovo yasekhaya nentsha (eneminyaka engama-15-24) kanye nezingxoxo zamaqembu okugxilwe kuwo, izingxoxo ezijulile kanye nezingxoxo zabantu abanolwazi phakathi kwentsha nababambe iqhaza emphakathini ngo-2016 no-2017.
Izibalo ezichazayo kanye nokuhlaziya okuqukethwe kwezindikimba kwenziwe.

Imiphumela yalesi sifundo iqinisekisa ezinye zezizathu zokusilela kwesondo/ukusilela kwesondo (FGM/C) okubhalwe yiwo amanye ama-study, iphawula ukuthi lezi zizathu zixhunyaniswe ngokuqinile, futhi izindinganiso zobulili yiyona yona eholela.
Kwezinhlu ezintathu, lezizathu ziqhuba ukuguqulwa kwamizimba yabesifazane ukuze kuphume umzimba “oqhubekile” owamukelwa yisimo esiphethe ilungelo labantu besilisa.
Lokhu kuholela ‘emzimbeni ohlanzekile’ e-Indonesia, ‘emzimbeni oqeqeshwe’ e-Ethiopia, nase ‘mzimbeni omdala’ eKenya.
Abasebenzi bezempilo nabazali badlala indima ebalulekile ekwenzeni izinqumo mayelana nokuqeda ukusoka kwabesifazane/abantwana kuzo zonke izindawo.
EKhenya, ikakhulukazi, abesifazane abasebasha bayaxoxisana ngendima yabo ekwenzeni izinqumo ezimayelana nokuhlatshwa kwesikhumba/ukusikwa kwesikhumba njengoba sebemdala ngesikhathi sokuhlatshwa.

Ucwaningo lubonisa ukuthi izimo zomthetho nemiphakathi eguqukayo kuyo yonke indawo ziletha izinguquko esikweni se-FGM/C okubangela ukwelashwa kwe-FGM/C e-Indonesia, ukwehla kweminyaka yokusika amantombazane eKenya kanye nokwenziwa kwe-FGM/C okukhuphuka phansi komhlaba e-Ethiopia.
Lezi zimo ezintathu zibonisa ukwahluka okukhulu ekwenzeni i-FGM/C kanye nencazelo yomphakathi ehambisana nayo ngamantombazane amancane nemiphakathi yabo.
Kunesidingo sokuqhubeka nokucwaninga indima yabazali ekwenzeni izinqumo.

Ngenxa yezixhumani phakathi kwabashayeli abahlukahlukene be-FGM/C ngaphakathi kwesimo ngasinye, ucwaningo luphetha ngokuthi izindlela ezifanele isimo kufanele zithathwe ukungenelela ukuze kudalwe ushintsho oluhlala isikhathi eside.
Ukuyeka ukusoka kwabesifazane, kuqala kudingeka siqonde ukuthi kungani kwenzeka.

Ukusithwa kwesitho sobulili sesifazane, umkhuba lapho izingxenye zezitho zocansi zesifazane zikhethwa khona noma zisuswa, kusawenzeka ngokungekho emthethweni noma ngasese emazweni afana neKenya, i-Ethiopia ne-Indonesia.
Abacwaningi bathi ukuqonda ukuthi kungani kwenzeka yikho okubalulekile ukuyeka lesi siko elilimaza, nokuvimbela izinkinga zezempilo nezingqondo abesifazane abazibhekana nazo ngenxa yalokho.
Ezingxenyeni zase-Afrika nase-Asia, ukusoka kwabesifazane (FGM), okubizwa ngokuthi ‘ukusoka kwabesifazane’, kusajwayelekile.

Abantu abaningi bakholelwa ngamanga ukuthi i-FGM iyadingeka ukuze kube nokuhlanzeka okuhle noma ukuze abesifazane bahlale bezothile (bengabi nazithukutheki futhi bathobekile), nokuqinisekisa ukuthi bazokwazi ukuba nezingane.
Ukuqothulwa kwesikhumba sobulili akudingeki kunoma yikuphi kula maphuzu ngokubhekisele ebufakazini besayensi.

Kepha, ezikhathini eziningi, izingane ezithintekile yi-FGM zigcina zinezinkinga zempilo kamuva ekuphileni, njengezifo ezilimazayo, ubunzima bokuthamba (ukuphuma kwamanzi), nezingqinamba zempilo yengqondo.
Ngenxa yokuthi lomkhuba ulimaza kakhulu futhi uyahlambalaza amalungelo abantu besifazane, amazwe amaningi umenze waba ngemthetho, kodwa abantu basaphikelela ngawo ngasese.
Kulolu cwaningo, abacwaningi babefuna ukuqonda okwengeziwe ukuthi kungani i-FGM yenzeka emazweni ahlukene, nokuthi abantu bakholelwa ini ngaleli qhekeza.
Ngakho-ke baqoqe ulwazi mayelana nokuqeda i-FGM eKenya, e-Ethiopia nase-Indonesia.

Ezweni ngalinye, abacwaningi bakhuluma nabantu ngaleyo nqubo, kuhlanganise abazali, intsha, abaholi besiko, abasebenzi bezempilo, kanye “nabokusika” (abesifazane abadala ababekade benza i-FGM kubantwana abesifazane abancane).
Kwezinye izimo, babexoxisana nabantu laba ngabanye, kodwa baphinde bakhulume namaqembu abantu, kuhlanganise nabantu abadala abasebancane nezingane ezikhulile, ababehlupheke yi-FGM.
Abacwaningi bathole ukuthi izizathu ze-FGM, indlela eyenziwa ngayo, kanye neenkolelo mayelana nenqubo, zazingefani kuwo wonke amazwe.
Baphinda bathola ukuthi abantu abaningi basaphila ngaleyo ndlela, ngisho nasezindaweni lapho kungekho emthethweni khona.

Ngokwesibonelo, e-Indonesia, abantu abadala abasebenza ngokuzala basebenzisa ummese noma unaliti ukunquma ingxenye yeklitorisi (umzimba obhekene kakhulu nenjabulo yobulili kwabesifazane) uma intombazane eneminyaka engu-40 ubudala.
Abantu bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kusiza ‘ukususa ubungcolile’ nokuthi kubalulekile ngezizathu zenkolo.
E-Ethiopia, ukusoka kwakwenzeka ngisho nakaseminyakeni emincane, ngezinye izikhathi lapho izingane zineminyaka engu-7 kuphela.

Abacwaningi bathola ukuthi abantu lapho bakholelwa ukuthi lokhu kuzoqinisekisa ukuthi intombazane izoba “umfazi omuhle” ngolunye usuku, nokuthi izoba yilowo oluthobekileyo, futhi ingabi nentukuthelo kumyeni wayo.
Abantu abaningi bakholelwa nokuthi ukusoka kwabesifazane kwenza kube lula ukubeletha, kodwa empeleni kwenza kube nzima ukubeletha.
Khonamanjalo eKenya, ukuqothulwa kwesikhumba kwakusho ukuthi intombazane ifinyelele ubulili bokukhula, futhi kwakwenzeka kamuva ekuphileni, lapho yayiseshumi nambili.

Kodwa-ke, kwezinye izimo, bathole ukuthi amantombazane angagqashulwa eneminyaka engu-8 ubudala, nokuthi amantombazane amaningi agcine ekhulelwe eseyintsha, ngoba ayebhekwa njengokwanele ukwenza ucansi ngemva kokugqashulwa.
Abacwaningi bathi imiphumela yabo ikhombisa ukuthi kunezizathu eziningi ezahlukene ezenza ukuba ukusoka kwabesifazane kusekhona.
Njengoba imithetho nemibono yomphakathi ishintsha, indlela nendawo okwenziwa ngayo nayo iyashintsha.
Isibonelo, abazali bangase bazame ukuyenza ngasese yize kungekho emthethweni, ngoba bacabanga ukuthi kuyadingeka ukuthi indodakazi yabo ibe nempilo enhle noma ithole umyeni omuhle.

Kubalulekile ukuqaphela ukuthi ngoba ukusoka kwabesifazane akuvumelekile kwezinye izindawo, ucwaningo lalo mbandela lungaba nzima, futhi abantu bangase bangabi namandla ukunika izimpendulo ezinyanisiwe ngale ndaba.

Abacwaningi bathi, esikhathini esizayo, ngaphezu kokwenza kube ngumthetho, ohulumeni neziphathimandla zezempilo kufanele baqonde ukuyeka ukusoka ngokubhekana nezimfundiso ezingamanga abantu abanawo ngaleli senzo nokubafundisa ngezingozi zalo.

Lolu cwaningo lwaluyisivumelwano phakathi kwesayensi base-Ethopia, e-Indonesia nase-Netherlands, futhi liyinxenye yephrojekthi enkulu, ebizwa nge ‘Yes I Do programme’, ehlose ukunciphisa ukukhulelwa kwabafana nabentombazane, umshado wabantwana kanye ne-FGM.

Ukudla okungcoliswe yi-vanadium kuye kwanda ngesikhathi samuva.
Le nsimbi iyinto eaziwayo enobhubhisi.
Ucwaningo lwamanje luqhutshelwe ukuphenya ubuthi bokuzala be-sodium metavanadate (SMV) emagundeni amakhulu ase-Afrika esilisa.
Ukuphathwa kwe-SMV kwenziwe ngaphakathi kwesisu nsuku zonke izinsuku ezingu-14 ezilandelayo ngezinga le-3mg/kg ubunzima bomzimba.
